About the Role

GTM Engineering sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, revenue generation, data, and automation, turning market intelligence and buyer insight into repeatable growth opportunities for PartsBase.

PartsBase is seeking a GTM Engineer to build and scale the workflows, systems, and outbound strategies that help our Sales teams engage the right aviation, aerospace, and defense buyers and suppliers at the right time. This is not a traditional demand generation or marketing operations role. GTM Engineers are hands-on builders who own the full lifecycle of a growth play, from identifying an opportunity and developing a hypothesis through workflow creation, experimentation, and measurable commercial impact.

The role combines growth marketing, account-based strategy, data enrichment, AI, and sales enablement. You will work directly with Sales to identify promising markets, uncover buying signals, map buying committees, and turn these insights into targeted outbound plays. Using Clay, AI, and connected data workflows, you will give sellers the context and tools they need to engage prospects more effectively and to convert them into active marketplace subscribers.

Success requires strong marketing judgment, technical curiosity, hands-on workflow-building experience, and the ability to connect automation to real commercial outcomes.

In This Role, You'll

 - Identify promising market segments, buying situations, and account-level triggers in partnership with Sales, such as fleet changes, new repair station certifications, AOG demand, and distributor expansion.

 - Develop targeted outbound plays, defining the audience, buyer problem, messaging, offer, seller action, and success criteria.

 - Build, own, and optimize Clay tables and research workflows, connecting enrichment, signal detection, account research, and contact discovery.

 - Use AI to interpret market signals, classify accounts, and generate relevant research and messaging inputs.

 - Map key accounts and buying committees across airlines, MROs, distributors, OEMs, and government and defense buyers, providing sellers with clear, evidence-based insights and recommended actions.

 - Work directly with Sales teams to test outbound plays, gather feedback, measure performance, and determine what to scale or refine.

 - Establish quality controls and source references to ensure research and AI-generated outputs are accurate and trustworthy.

 - Turn successful experiments into reusable workflows, signals, audience logic, and play templates.

 - Connect outbound strategies with ABM, paid media, and lifecycle marketing initiatives, including new subscriber acquisition, onboarding, engagement, and renewal.

 - Partner with RevOps on CRM integrations, sales tooling, tracking, and workflow governance.

What We're Looking For

 - Experience building B2B outbound, growth marketing, demand generation, or account-based marketing programs.

 - Strong marketing judgment across segmentation, buyer problems, positioning, and messaging.

 - Hands-on experience with Clay or similar data enrichment and workflow automation platforms.

 - Practical experience using AI for research, classification, personalization, and decision support.

 - A track record of working directly with Sales teams to turn growth ideas into executed outbound plays.

 - Experience identifying buying signals, researching accounts, and mapping buying committees.

 - The ability to distinguish verified evidence from assumptions and evaluate results critically.

 - A commercially minded approach, connecting growth activity to meetings, opportunities, and pipeline.

Required Skills

Growth Marketing and GTM Strategy

 - Understanding of B2B go-to-market strategies, outbound motions, demand generation, and ABM.

 - Ability to identify high-value segments and translate buyer insight into targeted growth plays.

 - Experience developing messaging and value propositions for specific audiences.

 - Attribution & Tracking: Strong grasp of UTM governance, campaign tracking, attribution modeling, and funnel analytics.

Technical and Automation Skills

 - Hands-on experience with Clay or comparable enrichment and automation platforms.

 - AI & Agentic Workflows: Hands-on experience building and running AI-powered workflows or agents in production, using tools like Claude, OpenAI, Clay, n8n, or HubSpot's AI features. You know where AI adds real leverage and where it adds noise.

 - HubSpot: Hands-on expertise, including workflows, scoring, lifecycle management, and building custom objects and data models.

 - Systems Architecture: A track record of designing and maintaining marketing and GTM systems, including website, CRM, and campaign infrastructure, and how they connect.

 - Integrations: Experience managing APIs, middleware tools, and data syncs across GTM systems, connecting data sources, research workflows, and automation tools.

 - Ability to structure data, troubleshoot workflows, and maintain data quality.

Sales Partnership and Execution

 - Proven ability to work closely with Sales teams to develop and execute outbound strategies.

 - Ability to translate account insights into clear seller context and actionable recommendations.

 - Experience gathering feedback, improving adoption, and measuring commercial impact.

Day-to-Day Activities

 - Identify growth opportunities through market research, buyer signals, and Sales feedback.

 - Build and maintain Clay tables for account enrichment, contact discovery, research, and prioritization.

 - Develop AI-powered workflows that generate accurate account insights and seller context.

 - Create and launch targeted outbound plays with Sales teams.

 - Analyze performance across engagement, meetings, opportunities, and pipeline.

 - Refine, scale, or retire workflows based on results and seller feedback.

 - Develop reusable research components, signals, and play templates.

 - Work with RevOps on ORO, tracking, and governance.

 - Document workflows and best practices to support adoption across teams and markets.

Personal Attributes

 - Builder mentality: enjoys getting hands-on with tools, data, workflows, and automation.

 - Commercially minded, focused on generating meaningful sales conversations, opportunities, and pipeline.

 - Naturally curious about buyer behavior, aviation aftermarket dynamics, and emerging technologies.

 - Analytical and evidence-driven, with strong attention to research quality and accuracy.

 - Experimentation-focused, comfortable testing ideas and learning from results.

 - Collaborative and confident working directly with Sales and cross-functional teams.

 - Self-starter who takes ownership and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

 - Excited by the potential of AI, automation, and connected data to transform go-to-market strategies.

Nice to Have

 - Experience with ORO, Salesforce, Marketo, Demandbase, Goldcast, or Qualified.

 - Familiarity with sales engagement platforms and outbound sequencing tools.

 - Experience building dashboards and analysis in tools like Power BI, Looker, or Tableau.

 - Background in aviation, aerospace, defense, or B2B marketplace businesses (a plus, not a requirement).

AI at PartsBase

AI is not a feature at PartsBase; it is a new way of working. It turns instructions into work done and helps us move faster for the buyers and suppliers who depend on us to source critical aviation parts. We expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. PartsBase sits at a rare intersection of marketplace data, aviation industry relationships, and deep aftermarket expertise, and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of applying AI to it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment, but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PartsBase is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants, and we make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you need an accommodation during the application or interview process, please let us know.

title: GTM engineer, Growth & PLG
description:
ABOUT LEMLIST

lemlist is the AI-powered sales engagement platform helping sales teams build pipeline smarter, not harder.

Bootstrapped from day one, we’ve grown from 0 to $50M+ ARR in 8 years without raising a single dollar. Today, 40,000+ sales teams use lemlist to book more meetings and close more deals.

We’re building the next generation of outbound: AI-first, multi-channel, highly personalized, and deeply integrated into the way modern sales teams work.

And we’re just getting started.

 

lemlist is hiring a GTM Engineer, Growth & PLG to run outbound like a paid channel: relevant at scale, fast tests, ruthless on what works.

We sell outbound software, so our own outbound has to be the best in the market. Today one GTM Engineer runs it for the whole company, and outbound went from 11% to 40% of the MRR we sign each month in a year. We start with the US, our biggest market, where we've barely scratched the surface. Then we test every other market we sell in.

So we're building a duo. Hugo, our GTM Engineer on Sales-led & BDR, owns outbound for the sales team and the engine it runs on: the living TAM, signals and scoring. 
You'll be the other half and push the engine further every week. 
You own growth-led outbound and PLG: you launch campaigns across the whole market, test angles nobody tried, run the sending infra, and bring what wins back into the system.

And you'll show how you do it, in public. The bar is the best outbound operators out there, the ones who publish their plays every week.

About us: bootstrapped from day one, 0 to $50M+ ARR in 8 years without raising a single dollar, 40,000+ sales teams. You'll report to Erwan (VP Growth) and work every day with Hugo (GTM Engineer, Sales-led & BDR), plus our launches, the GTM Club and the sales team.




WHAT YOUR IMPACT WILL LOOK LIKE


WITHIN 3 MONTHS, YOU'LL HAVE:

 - Taken over growth outbound end to end, starting with the US, and shipped a V1 strategy: segments, offers, angles, ramp-up plan

 - Built a sending infra that grows with deliverability first, with inbox placement you test every week

 - Launched at least 3 new campaigns every week, all synced to our TAM and CRM

 - Set up our reach-out rules in lemlist with Hugo, so no lead gets contacted too often by us

 - Published your first 6 "how lemlist uses lemlist" breakdowns


WITHIN 12 MONTHS, YOU'LL HAVE:

 - Scaled our sending without hurting deliverability or reply rates

 - Covered our whole US self-serve TAM (every account touched at least once a year) and started testing our other markets

 - Turned outbound into a trial machine: 10+ trials a day, tracked from first email to first payment

 - Measured outbound's influence on pipeline: accounts you touched that convert through another channel, against a control group

 - Graduated at least 5 plays into Hugo's evergreen system

 - Made "how lemlist uses lemlist" a weekly series, with real campaigns and real numbers
   
   


WHAT YOU'LL DO CONCRETELY


RUN OUTBOUND LIKE ADS

 - Think in reach, frequency and creative fatigue, like a media buyer

 - Cover the market, US first, then the rest of the world: founders, small teams and the ICs inside big companies

 - Watch our small customers (under 5 seats): spot the ones who start hiring, and bring the others into the GTM Club

 - Run the same growth playbook for Claap, our second product, with Clément who owns Claap outbound

 - Price every test before you launch it, then kill it or scale it


OWN THE INFRA

 - Domains, mailboxes, warm-up, rotation, inbox placement: you build it and you keep it healthy

 - Plan capacity ahead of each launch, so we never slow down because the infra can't follow

 - Keep your infra separate from our sales identities, their deliverability comes first


WRITE COPY PEOPLE ANSWER

 - Creative scenarios: why this campaign, why now, after which event

 - Precise copy: hit the exact pain of the exact persona, in their words, pulled from sales calls and prospect replies

 - Industrialize it with AI, then read samples yourself. AI drafts, you decide


FEED THE ENGINE

 - Pull from Hugo's TAM, enrich it, and push every result back into it

 - Replies to your campaigns flow into the conversation-to-meeting system Hugo owns: an AI agent handles some of them, the rest go to the right sales rep

 - Document every winning play so it can run without you


LAUNCH OUR PRODUCTS TO THE MARKET

 - Every launch (MCP, Dialer, Lead Finder, what comes next) gets an outbound play to prospects

 - Sell lemlist with lemlist: everything runs in lemlist and through our MCP, and you send product feedback when something blocks you


SHOW HOW LEMLIST USES LEMLIST

 - Turn your real campaigns into posts, breakdowns, GTM Club sessions and webinars

 - Show real numbers and real lists, mistakes included

 - Share the stage with Hugo: you cover growth and PLG, he covers sales-led and BDR
   
   


ABOUT YOU

Location: Paris HQ or remote in Europe, with a good overlap on US hours.

 - Deliverability expert: you've run sending infra at scale and kept emails in the inbox. You can walk us through your setup

 - Copy that lands: you can show campaigns that booked meetings or drove signups, and explain why they worked

 - AI-native: you build lists, copy and campaigns with Claude, agents or Clay, and they run in production today

 - Fast and system-minded: you ship a campaign in hours, and you know a test only counts once it runs in a system without you

 - Data-driven: you track from first email to first payment, and you know when a number is lying

 - Content builder: you can turn a real campaign into a post or a breakdown people actually read, and you want to do it every week. You don't need an audience, you need the appetite

 - Fluent in English


BONUS POINTS

 - Native English, for the content part

 - You already share your work publicly and have an audience that follows it

 - You've run outbound for a PLG product, where the goal was a trial, not a meeting

 - You've worked in a cold email agency at scale


NOT FOR YOU IF…

 - You think more emails fix a bad message

 - You need a brief before you launch anything

 - You buy lists and blast them without reading a sample

 - You build your own little system on the side instead of feeding the shared one

 - You want to run campaigns but not talk about them
   
   


INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Interview with Erwan (VP Growth)

 - 48-hour use case, debrief with Hugo (GTM Engineer, Sales-led & BDR) and Erwan (VP Growth)

 - Fit check with Domitille (CMO) and Victor (GTM Club)

 - Interview with Charles (CEO)

 - Reference check

 - Offer

title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
description:
lemlist is the outbound platform for sales teams: find leads, run multichannel campaigns (email, LinkedIn, calls), personalize with AI and book meetings.

lempire also builds lemwarm (deliverability), Claap (AI call intelligence), Taplio and Tweet Hunter.

We're at +$60M ARR, growing ~50% year over year, profitable and 100% bootstrapped, with 180 people.




YOUR MISSION

lemlist and Claap sell through several motions at once: self-serve, sales-led, account management and partners. More than a quarter of our ARR sits in 1,200+ accounts managed by our Customer Success and Account Management teams. In 2027, these teams start working the same portfolio under a new customer segmentation, and expanding our existing accounts, including cross-selling Claap and our new products, is one of our biggest bets of the year.

As Senior Revenue Operations Manager (Customer Ops), your mission is to design how our revenue motions run, and own the systems and data behind them. In the short term, your focus is customer operations, from the moment Sales hands over an account to every renewal and expansion. Over time, the role can evolve toward Sales ops, Partnerships or other revenue topics, depending on your strengths, your interests and company priorities.

You'll join our Finance & Operations team, six people today, and report to Philippe, Head of Finance & Operations. Your main stakeholders are the leaders of Customer Experience, Account Management, Sales and Partnerships.

This is a hands-on role. You'll spend most of your time in HubSpot, our customer tools, automations and dashboards, building things people use every day. You also bring the business view: you know your numbers better than anyone, and you turn them into clear recommendations for the teams you work with.




WHERE YOU'LL MAKE AN IMPACT


YOUR FIRST FOCUS: CUSTOMERS

Give customer teams one view of every account. Bring product usage, billing and CRM data together, so every account tells the full story in one place. Own the build-or-buy decision on our customer platform, lead the rollout, and build with the Data team the dashboards that make CSMs' day-to-day easier and give leadership clear visibility on the customer base.

Build our risk detection engine. Turn usage, payment and engagement signals into early alerts across the whole portfolio, from our largest accounts with a dedicated CSM to the ones we manage at scale, so teams act on churn risk weeks before a renewal.

Make renewals and NRR predictable. With our VP CX and Account Management leaders, build the renewal and NRR forecast leadership can rely on, at least two quarters ahead, and know which accounts will grow, stay or churn.

Turn our customer base into expansion revenue. Give Account Managers and CSMs the signals and pipeline to upsell and cross-sell Claap and our new products, and track what it brings.


ALSO IN YOUR SCOPE

Alongside customer ops, you'll contribute to the rest of our RevOps work:

 - Sales: make selling lemlist, Claap and new products simple for our reps, with lead routing, pipeline and performance tracking, and clear rules of engagement between Sales, Account Management and partners.

 - Partners: make partner deals easy to track, credit and pay, from PartnerStack to the CRM, so the Partnerships team can scale its programs in Europe and the US.

 - Systems: keep CRM and revenue data reliable as we add products, run commission plans people trust, and replace manual work with automations and AI agents.
   
   


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE


WITHIN YOUR FIRST 3 MONTHS

 - You've audited our customer motion and shared a 12-month plan with Guillaume our VP CX and Account Management leaders.

 - The customer platform decision is made, based on your recommendation.

 - A first version of the churn risk alerts is live for CSMs.


WITHIN 12 MONTHS

 - CSMs and Account Managers work from one view of every account, with usage, billing and CRM data they trust.

 - Churn risks are flagged weeks ahead, and teams act on them before the renewal.

 - Leadership plans on your renewal and NRR forecast

 - You've turned the CRM into an expansion and pipeline generation tool, across lemlist and Claap.

 - Your work contributes to a measurable lift in net revenue retention (NRR) on the managed portfolio.

 - Sales and Partnerships see the difference too: clear rules of engagement, reliable routing, and partner deals credited and paid on time.
   
   


WHO YOU ARE

 - 5+ years in RevOps or GTM Ops in B2B SaaS, ideally PLG + SLG.

 - You've owned customer operations for a portfolio at scale (health scores, churn risk, renewal forecasting), and led at least one big change: a tool rollout, a new coverage model or a new customer segmentation. Sales or partner ops experience is a plus.

 - Hands-on CRM admin experience (HubSpot)

 - Experience with a customer platform (Gainsight, ChurnZero, Planhat or similar) is a plus.

 - Business sense: you turn data into a recommendation and defend it with senior stakeholders.

 - You're used to working with VPs and the C-level, and you don't need a brief to start.

 - Builder mindset: you automate, use AI daily, document what you build and close what you start.

 - Fluent French and English.

If you read our values https://lemlist.com/join-lemlist and thought "this is 100% me", you'll thrive in this role.




WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

 - A senior role with real ownership in a small team: you shape how a $60M+ ARR company sells and grows its customers.

 - You own the customer ops function

 - Direct work with VPs, the COO and the CEO.

 - AI by default: we already run AI agents on our CRM and internal tools, and we expect you to reach for AI first in everything you build.

 - Profitable, bootstrapped and growing 40+% a year: you build for growth without fundraising pressure.

 - Remote-friendly, async culture, with a Paris office.
   
   


RECRUITMENT PROCESS

 1. Interview with Victoire (Lead TA).

 2. Interview with Oriane (COO).

 3. Business case (async) and live debrief with Philippe (Head of Finance & Operations) and Guillaume (VP Customer).

 4. Final interview with Charles (CEO).

 5. Reference checks and offer.

title: GTM Engineer – HubSpot, Automation & AI (f/m/d)
description:
Location: Remote CET ±4h

Team: Marketing

 

About Kubermatic

At Kubermatic, we believe that businesses should focus on their core purpose: writing groundbreaking applications, not operations. In line with our commitment to make Kubernetes as easy as possible, we help IT teams worldwide to fully automate their Kubernetes and cloud native operations across multi-cloud, edge, and on-prem.

As one of the top corporate contributors to the Kubernetes Project, we develop enterprise-grade software solutions and provide professional services and support to safely navigate and accelerate your cloud native transformation. Our open source Kubermatic Kubernetes Platform makes it easy to operate thousands of Kubernetes clusters on any infrastructure.

If you are looking for a neatly structured environment, we are just not a good match. But if you are thrilled by the prospect of joining a technology start-up with a lot of room for your own ideas and personal growth, we definitely should at least have a chat.

 

The Opportunity

HubSpot is our main CRM and the place where all our marketing, sales and event data comes together. We're looking for a GTM Engineer who owns that system and builds on top of it: how our tools are set up, how data flows between them, whether our tracking tells us what's working, and how we turn that data into automated workflows that help sales and marketing reach the right people at the right time.

The role combines two jobs. The RevOps part keeps our revenue process clean and predictable: lifecycle stages, routing, data quality, attribution and reporting. The GTM engineering part builds new systems with automation, APIs and AI: enrichment, signal-based follow-ups and workflows that replace manual work. You'll work hands-on in the tools every day: this is a builder role, not a campaign-execution role.



What success looks like

 - First 30 days: You know our HubSpot portal inside out: properties, pipelines, workflows, forms, integrations and users. You've mapped how our tools connect today, where data breaks or goes missing, and which manual GTM tasks cost the team the most time.

 - First 60 days: You've fixed the most critical gaps: key integrations run reliably, lifecycle stages, lead sources and routing rules are defined consistently, and GA4/HubSpot tracking is verified end-to-end for our main conversion points. Your first automation that removes manual work for sales or marketing is live.

 - First 90 days: You own our GTM stack. There's a documented data model and integration map, a clean-up routine for the database, a working enrichment and lead-prioritisation flow, and dashboards the marketing and sales teams trust and use.



Key Responsibilities

 - HubSpot ownership: Administer and configure our HubSpot portal: properties, lifecycle stages, lead scoring, pipelines, forms, lists, user permissions and settings. Keep HubSpot the single source of truth for customer and contact data.

 - Revenue process & routing: Define and maintain lifecycle stages, lead status, lead routing and the handoff between marketing and sales, including SLAs and clear ownership at each stage.

 - Integrations & data flow: Set up, connect and maintain the tools around HubSpot (e.g. Make, Luma, Pretix, Google Analytics, website forms) so that data syncs correctly and nothing gets lost between systems.

 - GTM automation: Build workflows that turn signals into action: enrichment of new contacts and accounts, scoring and prioritisation, event follow-ups, and alerts that give sales the context to reach out at the right time.

 - AI-assisted workflows: Use LLMs, APIs and scripts to automate research, enrichment and data clean-up that is done by hand today, and document how each workflow works so the team can rely on it.

 - Tracking & attribution: Implement and maintain tracking across website, campaigns and events (GA4, HubSpot tracking code, UTM conventions, conversion events), and make sure every touchpoint is attributed correctly in HubSpot.

 - Data quality: Own database hygiene: deduplication, property standards, segmentation, consent/opt-in status (GDPR) and regular clean-ups.

 - Reporting & pipeline visibility: Build HubSpot and GA4 dashboards that show campaign, event and pipeline performance from first touch to closed deal, and help the team read and act on them.

 - Enablement & documentation: Document setups, naming conventions and processes, and support marketing, sales and event colleagues in using HubSpot and our automations correctly.



What You Bring

Must-haves

 - Hands-on experience administering HubSpot (Marketing Hub, Sales Hub and CRM): properties, workflows, lifecycle stages, pipelines, lists, forms and reporting.

 - You've built automations and integrations yourself, with Make, n8n, Zapier or native integrations, and you're comfortable working with APIs, webhooks and JSON.

 - Scripting skills in Python, JavaScript or similar: enough to call an API, transform data or write a custom code step in a workflow.

 - Practical experience with web and campaign tracking: GA4, UTM structures, conversion tracking and attribution.

 - An understanding of how B2B sales and marketing work day to day: lead qualification, handoffs, pipeline stages and what a rep needs to act on a lead.

 - A strong eye for data quality: you've structured, cleaned and maintained a CRM database before.

 - Fluent English (C1); you can explain technical setups clearly to non-technical colleagues.

Nice-to-haves

 - Experience building AI or LLM steps into GTM workflows, e.g. for account research, enrichment or lead summaries.

 - Experience with Clay or similar enrichment tools, or with intent and signal data.

 - HubSpot certifications or admin experience in a B2B SaaS company.

 - Experience with Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio or a data warehouse such as BigQuery.

 - A background in a sales-facing or ops role (SDR, AE, sales or marketing ops), or knowledge of the cloud-native and Kubernetes market.

 - Working knowledge of GDPR requirements for marketing data and consent management.

 - German language skills.

If you meet most of the must-haves, please apply. We care more about what you've built than about ticking every box.



Team & Working Environment

You'll work closely with marketing, sales and the events team, and with our engineering colleagues when a workflow needs product data or internal APIs. You report to the Head of Marketing. The role is remote, 40h/week. Our working language is English.



Ready to Apply?

If you like turning manual go-to-market work into systems that run on their own, and making sure the data behind them is right, we'd like to hear from you. Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile, ideally with a short description of something you built; no cover letter or photo needed.

Kubermatic welcomes applications from all people, regardless of gender, age, origin, religion, disability or sexual orientation. If you need any accommodations during the application process, just let us know.

Apply now!

title: Founding GTM Engineer
description:
Here at Magic, we're personalizing real world experiences. Our first product, Loyalist, is an agentic CRM for restaurants. We partner with 1,000+ venues across 180+ cities, from Carbone to 4 Charles to Eleven Madison Park. We're expanding into members clubs, hotels, and more.

We sell in person. Our team walks into restaurants, hosts dinners for operators, and shows up at the industry's events. We're looking for a founding GTM engineer to build the system behind that motion. You'll own the data, tools, and AI agents that tell our team which groups to meet, who runs them, and what each event and conversation actually produced.

This is a builder role. You'll run our enrichment and programmatic outbound, and you'll build the internal tools that sales, customer experience, and growth use every day. You'll report to our Head of Growth and work closely with the marketing and growth team, as well as founders, sales, and customer experience.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and manage our internal GTM platform. Develop our data enrichment processes and build the agents that power our go-to-market motion

 - Build and run programmatic outbound, including cold email, end to end: targeting, sequencing, and reply handling, plus the infrastructure behind it (sending domains, warmup, and deliverability)

 - Own lead scoring and lifecycle. Score every account on signals like new openings, chef and GM changes, and groups switching reservation or POS systems, then build the lifecycle automations that move it from first touch to closed, onboarded, and expanding

 - Build tools that make sales and customer experience feel superhuman, e.g. a context transfer layer between the two teams or a meeting scheduler for the sales team

 - Partner with marketing and growth to turn our data into campaigns, events, and programs that drive pipeline, and support on SEO / AEO

 - Own GTM reporting and connect our tools, so sales, customer experience, and growth work from the same data and can see what each channel and event produced


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 3+ years of experience across GTM engineering, engineering, demand gen, or RevOps

 - Some background in marketing and growth preferred

 - Experience with data enrichment. You know the providers, waterfalls, and how to get a clean, verified list

 - You can build distributed systems

 - Experience running programmatic outbound, including cold email at scale, with the deliverability to match. You understand the statistics of domain, IP, and copy health

 - High competence with Claude and Clay. You've built real workflows and tools with both, not just prompts in a chat window, and you have a strong point of view on the best tools and integrations for each task

 - You enjoy supporting teammates. You turn what sales, customer experience, and marketing ask for into tools they actually use

 - You care about data quality. Duplicates and wrong location counts bother you

 - High ownership and a bias toward shipping

 - Bonus: experience in or around restaurants or hospitality


WHO THRIVES HERE

 - You want to be early and own a system end to end

 - You'd rather ship a working tool this week than a perfect one next quarter

 - You like being close to the field. You'll join walk-ins and events to see how the data gets used


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Salary range $150,000-$190,000 and equity

 - We work in person 5 days a week in our SoHo office

 - Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance for you and all your dependents (FSA and HSA plans available)

 - Lunch daily from the best restaurants in NYC; you choose all the restaurants your first week

 - A day trailing a restaurant, so you see what our customers live every day

 - Unlimited PTO

title: Marketing Ops
description:
ABOUT US

Parallel is a web infrastructure company. Our products are used by leading businesses in sales, marketing, insurance, and coding to build best-in-class AI agents with flexible and powerful programmatic access to the web.



We've raised $230 million from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Index Ventures, Spark Capital, Khosla Ventures, First Round, and Terrain to build the web for AIs. We're currently valued at $2 billion and we're forming a world-class team of engineers, designers, marketers, sellers, researchers, and operational experts to achieve our mission.



Job: You will own Parallel's marketing systems and the data that runs through them. You'll own the HubSpot and Salesforce integration. Together with Revenue Operations, you'll move us to an account- and contact-based model that sales and marketing both trust. You'll build lead scoring and the attribution model that shows which demand generation actually creates pipeline. With data engineering, you'll rebuild how product data flows from BigQuery into our marketing systems, so the whole team acts on usage signals as well as form fills. You'll run the stack end to end, from enrichment and events to reporting, and build agentic workflows where they beat a manual process.

You: You’re a problem-solver and inherently fired up by challenges. You’re curious about new technology and approach it from an experimental mentality. You have bias to action and know how to balance short term progress with longer term systems-building. You've owned the marketing technology stack at a B2B or developer-first company: marketing automation, BI, enrichment, events and the ETL behind them.




LIFE AT PARALLEL

We believe in a fully in person work culture 5 days a week. We’re building strong offices in San Francisco, Palo Alto, Austin, and New York. Your office and in office days will depend on your team, and we will walk you through the details during the interview process. We’re a flat, talent-dense organization dedicated to solving technical and creative problems.



We seek like-minded individuals who share our passion for applying science, creativity, and consistency to big and complex problems with equally big outcomes. These are our values:

 - Own customer impact: It’s on us to ensure real-world outcomes for our customers.

 - Obsess over craft: Perfect every detail because quality compounds.

 - Accelerate change: Ship fast, adapt faster, and move frontier ideas into production.

 - Create win-wins: Creatively turn trade-offs into upside.

 - Make high-conviction bets: Try and fail. But succeed an unfair amount.




COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary

 - Generous equity

 - Visa sponsorships

 - 401K plans

 - Daily lunch & office snacks

 - Dinner at the office

 - Unlimited vacation

 - Caltrain pass reimbursement

title: Director, GTM Operations
description:
AI AT ZAPIER

At Zapier https://zapier.com/about, we build and use automation every day to make work more efficient, creative, and human. So if you’re using AI tools while applying here - that’s great! We just ask that you use them responsibly and transparently.

Check out our guidance on How to Collaborate with AI During Zapier’s Hiring Process https://zapier.com/l/jobs/ai-at-zapier, including how to use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or others during our hiring process - and when not to.

 

Zapier is the most connected AI orchestration platform, and the way companies discover, adopt and buy it is changing. Work increasingly starts with an agent that picks Zapier, proves itself in production and grows into a company-wide standard. I’m hiring a Director of GTM Operations to reimagine how our go-to-market operates as that shift happens, and to expand Zapier on Zapier, so our own teams showcase what AI orchestration can do at scale.

You’ll own GTM Operations end to end, leading about five direct reports across strategy, program management, and systems and platform architecture, plus operators embedded across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Support and Partnerships. You’ll build a lot of the systems yourself, direct bigger builds through your team and our engineering partners, and own what you ship after launch. You’ll report to the Senior Director, Technical Operations and Automation Platform, and work directly with our CRO, Sales and Marketing leaders, Finance and our COO.

Our Sales and Marketing leaders set the targets and the strategy, and Finance owns comp and commissions. You own the systems, data and operating rhythm behind that strategy, and you’re accountable for whether it succeeds. You show leaders what’s working, tell them when the numbers point somewhere else, and bring them proposals for what should change, with the trade-offs laid out.

This is an AI transformation role for GTM. With agents handling more of the routine work, our teams can reach more customers, act faster when prospects show interest, and spend their time where a human makes the difference. You’ll lead that shift: start from what already exists, decide where agents have the most impact, build or direct them, and prove it’s working.

 - Our Commitment to Applicants https://zapier.com/jobs/our-commitment-to-applicants/

 - Culture and Values at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/culture-and-values-at-zapier/

 - Zapier Guide to Remote Work https://zapier.com/learn/remote-work/

 - Zapier Code of Conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct/

 - Diversity and Inclusivity at Zapier https://zapier.com/jobs/working-on-diversity-and-inclusivity/

About You

 - You focus on business outcomes. You know the revenue targets, and measure your work by its impact.

 - You see across all of GTM. You look across the business, not just one team’s work. When several teams are solving the same problem in different ways, you notice, and drive alignment.

 - You build with AI and plan for what comes after launch. You’ve built or led the build of agents, automations and GTM systems such as routing, lead scoring or attribution. You can show what changed as a result. You design for scale from the start: who owns it, how it’s maintained, how it stays secure, and what governance it needs. You build small things yourself, and you understand larger builds well enough to direct engineering and judge whether they’ll hold up.

 - You decide what not to build. You start from the business goal and work back to what’s needed. You’d rather do fewer things well, and you retire what isn’t working instead of building around it.

 - You’ve owned GTM outcomes in a sales-led business. You’ve been accountable for how leads, pipeline, routing and revenue connect, and measured the results. That experience could come from RevOps, GTM engineering, pre- or post sales, or marketing leadership.

 - You’ve supported more than one sales motion at once. For example: self-serve, mid-market and enterprise. Ideally you’ve been through a shift from product-led to sales-led growth. You know where the rules need to differ between motions.

 - You work hands-on with data and systems. You write your own SQL, and you’ve worked in HubSpot or Salesforce and a data warehouse such as Databricks or Snowflake. You question numbers that look wrong, and when the data doesn’t support the plan, you say so.

 - You influence senior leaders. You’ve worked directly with VP- and executive-level leaders who wanted different things. You’ve laid out the options and trade-offs, helped them reach a decision, and secured people and budget through written proposals.

 - You lead distributed teams. You’ve managed people across time zones, including senior individual contributors. You address performance issues early, delegate ownership clearly, and make sure every system other teams rely on has a named owner, regular reviews and a plan for when it fails.

 - You drive adoption, not just delivery. You help leaders use their own data and test their own ideas, and you measure whether what you shipped is actually being used.

 - You’re comfortable with work that’s still taking shape. Parts of our GTM are experimental. You can support that without locking it into a fixed process too early.

Nice to have

 - You’ve got an engineering background. You’ve worked as a software or data engineer, so building and debugging come naturally to you.

 - You’ve seen a shift from PLG to SLG. You know what changes when a self-serve business shifts to Enterprise.

 - You’ve built lead scoring or prioritisation. You’ve designed ways to rank leads or accounts so reps know where to spend their time and what to do next.

 - You’ve used modern GTM tools. You’ve worked hands-on with tools like Clay, Gong or data enrichment platforms, and you know where they help and where they don’t.



What you'll do

 - Start with an audit. Review what already exists, including programs that have stalled, underutilized or abandoned tools, and reports and workflows that no longer serve the strategy. Once leaders agree, retire them, so new work isn’t built on top of old problems.

 - Reimagine GTM work with agents. Find where agents would make the biggest difference, build or direct them, measure what changes, and own them after launch, including maintenance, security and governance.

 - Own lead flow end to end. Make routing clear and reliable. Be the person who can explain how it works, and change it quickly when needed to drive outcomes. Define what counts as a misrouted lead, and track it weekly.

 - Deliver real-time lead routing and prioritization as your first major project. Every new lead gets sorted in real time so it reaches the right team for its likely deal size, and ranked so reps know which leads to act on first.

 - Own target account lists. Take the criteria Sales and Marketing leaders set, work with our data and enrichment vendors to build the lists, and keep them current.

 - Create one trusted set of GTM numbers. Build a standard set of metrics, with filters and drill-downs, that Sales and Marketing leaders use in their own business reviews.

 - Show what’s working. Build attribution across GTM so we can see what a deal was worth at the start, what changed, who worked on it, and which tactics made the difference.

 - Measure experiments. When a team tries something new, set up a simple way to tell whether it worked, and make sure the results reach the people who need them.

 - Turn decisions into delivery. When GTM leaders have agreed on what to do and how they’ll measure it, get it built through your team. You own the GTM Operations roadmap.

 - Run intake across GTM. Every request has a clear owner, a priority and a path. Balance day-to-day requests, larger roadmap projects and quick experiments so nothing important stalls.

 - Lead GTM Operations. Manage about five direct reports across strategy, program management, and systems and platform architecture, plus operators embedded across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Support and Partnerships. Set direction, remove blockers and develop the team.

 - Partner across teams. Work with our AI engineering team on larger builds, a dedicated data partner on analysis, Revenue Enablement on rep coaching, and Finance and Business Operations on comp, commissions and deal desk.

 - Work transparently. Document decisions and trade-offs, and write the proposals that get leaders to agree and commit people and budget.

Impact matters more than tenure. You’ve led people, whether as a manager or a hands-on lead. You’ve set clear direction, made ownership clear, helped people grow, and addressed performance when it mattered. Beyond that, show us the best thing you’ve built or led with AI. Tell us what business problem it solved and why it was the right thing to build, including what you chose not to build. Tell us how you designed it to scale: who owns it, how it’s maintained and secured, and how it’s governed. And tell us what changed for the business, who uses it, and how you know it’s working.


HOW TO APPLY

At Zapier, we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us better, which is why we have a non-standard application process designed to promote inclusion and equity. We're looking for the best fit for each of our roles, regardless of the type of companies in your background, so we encourage you to apply even if your skills and experiences don’t exactly match the job description. All we ask is that you answer a few in-depth questions in our application that would typically be asked at the start of an interview process. This helps speed things up by letting us get to know you and your skillset a bit better right out of the gate. Please be sure to answer each question; the resume and CV fields are optional.

Education is not a requirement for our roles; however, if you receive an offer, you will need to include your most recent educational experience as part of our background check process.

After you apply, you are going to hear back from us—even if we don’t see an immediate fit with our team. In fact, throughout the process, we strive to never go more than seven days without letting you know the status of your application. We know we’ll make mistakes from time to time, so if you ever have questions about where you stand or about the process, just ask your recruiter!

Zapier is an equal-opportunity employer and we're excited to work with talented and empathetic people of all identities. Zapier does not discriminate based on someone's identity in any aspect of hiring or employment as required by law and in line with our commitment to Diversity, Inclusion, Belonging and Equity. Our code of conduct https://zapier.com/jobs/zapier-code-of-conduct provides a beacon for the kind of company we strive to be, and we celebrate our differences because those differences are what allow us to make a product that serves a global user base. Zapier will consider all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

Zapier prioritizes the security of our customers' information and is dedicated to adhering to all applicable data privacy laws. You can review our privacy policy here https://zapier.com/legal/data-privacy.

Zapier is committed to inclusion. As part of this commitment, Zapier welcomes applications from individuals with disabilities and will work to provide reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are needed to participate in the job application or interview process, please contact jobs@zapier.com.




APPLICATION DEADLINE:

The anticipated application window is 30 days from the date job is posted, unless the number of applicants requires it to close sooner or later, or if the position is filled.

Even though we’re an all-remote company, we still need to be thoughtful about where we have Zapiens working. Check out this resource https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1_lXQvKwuU4xXEbye7EW_En8iv1ZIMlQNmT7B2Mzbo24/edit?gid=0#gid=0 for a list of countries where we currently cannot have Zapiens permanently working.

title: Manager, GTM Engineer
description:
Company Description

We’re  http://checkout.comCheckout.com http://Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. 


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. 

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. 

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. 

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.



At Checkout.com http://Checkout.com, we create marketing that moves people to choose our products, builds a brand where great marketers want to work, and fuels the growth of our business.

We’re looking for a GTM Engineer to join Marketing and help transform how we work internally. You’ll design and build AI-assisted workflows, agents and integrations that reduce manual effort, improve how information moves across the team and give marketers more time to focus on high-value work.

Marketing Operations Team owns our marketing technology and tools, and the automation that supports go-to-market execution across our channels. This role works alongside Marketing Operations, with a different starting focus: improving the internal processes, workflows and systems that help Marketing plan and deliver its work. The aim is to 10x our impact.

This is a hands-on technical role in a marketing team. You’ll spend around 70% of your time building: understanding how work gets done, finding where it is manual or breaking down, and shipping practical solutions. You’ll partner closely with Marketing Operations to make sure what you build fits our existing tools and standards.

You’ll work across Marketing, in close partnerships across Marketing Operations, Commercial AI Transformation and the AI Centre of Excellence. You’ll bring a clear technical point of view on what is scalable and reliable, while making sure the systems you build are useful to the people who need them.




HOW YOU’LL MAKE AN IMPACT




FIND THE PROBLEMS WORTH SOLVING

Work with teams across Marketing to understand their processes and the work behind their requests. Map workflows, identify manual effort, duplicated work, missing context and avoidable errors, then prioritise opportunities based on their potential value. You’ll use your creativity and judgement rather than simply build to a ticket.




BUILD AI-ASSISTED WORKFLOWS AND INTEGRATIONS

Create and ship agents, automations, skills and integrations that make internal marketing work easier. You might use Claude Enterprise, Copilot Studio, Clay, MCP connectors, coding agents or other tools across our marketing stack. Work with Marketing Operations when a solution involves our marketing technology or channel tools.




MAKE INTERNAL MARKETING WORK MORE EFFICIENT

Build workflows that help teams do the work behind marketing more efficiently, from briefing, research and insight gathering to planning, content development and hand-offs. Connect information and tools so people spend less time on repetitive coordination and more time on work that needs their expertise. Partner with Marketing Operations where workflows touch marketing technology or channel execution.




BUILD SYSTEMS PEOPLE CAN RELY ON

Design beyond the individual task. Consider the data, context, tools, users, hand-offs, controls and feedback loops a workflow needs to work well. Identify where information is missing, where an agent needs better direction or where teams need support to use and improve the system.




HELP MARKETERS BUILD WITH AI

Work alongside marketers to show what is possible and help them use AI with confidence. Create reusable patterns, skills, playbooks and guardrails so teams can solve more problems themselves and repeat good practice.




TEST, LEARN AND IMPROVE

Prototype and test workflows, learn from how people use them, and improve or retire them based on the results. Identify design, security, privacy, brand and scale risks early, and follow our AI governance and review processes.




KEEP UP WITH THE TOOLS

Stay curious about new models, coding tools, connectors and agent patterns. Be able to explain which tools are right for a particular job and why, whether you’re comparing Claude, ChatGPT, coding agents or emerging platforms.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR




YOU BUILD THINGS

You’ve made working automations, prototypes, integrations, agents, internal tools or products, and enjoy taking a messy problem through to something people can use. Your job title matters less than what you’ve built and the value it creates.




YOU USE AI HANDS-ON

You use LLMs to get work done, not just to talk about what they could do. You’re comfortable prototyping with AI coding tools, testing different approaches, debugging and improving the result. You can show us something you’ve built with Claude, Codex, ChatGPT or another LLM platform, at work or in your own time.




YOU HAVE SOUND TECHNICAL JUDGEMENT

You can reason about systems, APIs, data flows, permissions and failure modes. You understand the difference between a promising demo and a dependable workflow. You don’t need a traditional software engineering background, but you do need to be comfortable working directly with technical tools and making sensible implementation choices.




YOU UNDERSTAND MARKETING AND GTM

You understand how demand generation, growth, customer marketing, marketing operations, sales and revenue processes connect. You’re familiar with concepts such as campaign briefs, segmentation, ABM, lead scoring, MQLs, MQAs, pipeline, attribution and lifecycle stages. You’re interested in the business outcomes behind the work.




YOU’VE WORKED ACROSS MARKETING OR REVOPS TOOLS

You’ve built or supported workflows across platforms such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Asana, Clay or similar tools. You can think across a stack rather than optimise one tool in isolation, and you’re comfortable with connectors, APIs, webhooks or MCP-style integrations.




YOU KNOW HOW TO DESIGN USEFUL WORKFLOWS AND AGENTS

You can give a workflow the context it needs, choose the right tools, define hand-offs, involve people at the right points and make outputs easy to review. You understand that an agent’s performance depends on its data and operating environment as well as the model.




YOU PRIORITISE FOR VALUE

You can judge which problems are worth solving, which should remain manual and where a simpler answer will work better. You balance speed, quality, risk, maintainability and commercial impact, and can make a clear case for what to build next.




YOU MEASURE AND IMPROVE YOUR WORK

You’re comfortable defining success measures, tracking usage and output, and deciding what to improve, stop or scale. You care about measurable gains in productivity, quality, speed or business impact.




YOU THINK IN SYSTEMS

You look for the process behind the immediate pain point. When a spreadsheet is difficult to use, for example, you’re curious about the data, decisions and hand-offs that created it, and what would make the process work better. You can hold the bigger picture while working through the details needed to ship.




YOU COMMUNICATE CLEARLY AND BRING PEOPLE WITH YOU

You can explain technical ideas to marketers, commercial leaders, Product, Engineering, Security, IT and Operations in a way that helps them make decisions. You listen well, communicate simply and influence through your work and judgement.




YOU’RE CURIOUS AND SELF-STARTING

You’re comfortable with ambiguity and motivated to learn. You’ve taught yourself new tools, built something outside your formal remit or pursued a technical interest in your own time. A personal project, prototype, automation, community contribution or other example could show us how you learn.




YOU USE AI RESPONSIBLY

You understand that marketing systems need to be accurate, secure, explainable and aligned with our brand and company standards. You know when people need to review an output, when data should not be used and when an experiment is not ready to scale.



You might come from marketing technology, marketing operations, growth engineering, RevOps, automation engineering, product, full-stack engineering or another technical role close to commercial teams. What matters most is your curiosity about marketing, your judgement about what is worth improving and your ability to build practical solutions.



Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.



Life at Checkout.com http://Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page https://www.checkout.com/careers to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com http://Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/checkout/life/ and Instagram https://www.instagram.com/checkout_com/

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
About Extend: 

 
 Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend's best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits. 
 
Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco. 
 About the Role 

 Most of Extend's revenue growth happens after the contract is signed: launching merchants well, then growing attach rates, categories and programs across our existing book. Extend is hiring a technical, AI-native Revenue Operations Manager to own the operations behind that post-sales motion.

 You'll be the RevOps lead for our Customer Success team (account managers who own merchant growth), our Solutions Engineering team, and the field teams that launch and support merchants. You'll own the planning, compensation, reporting and systems they run on, and you'll use tools like Claude Code, SQL and Salesforce automation to rebuild manual work instead of just maintaining it.

 What You'll Do 

 Annual Planning 

 

- Partner with Customer Success and Solutions Engineering leaders on annual planning: book-of-business and territory assignments, capacity models (accounts and workload per person), and growth targets for existing merchants. 

- Translate the company's revenue plan into targets for post-sales teams, and track progress against them through the year. 
 
 Commissions & Compensation Operations 

 

- Run commissions for post-sales roles: calculate quarterly payouts, validate them with Finance, and answer rep questions with a clear audit trail. 

- Prepare, route and track variable compensation plan documents for post-sales roles each cycle, and keep plan changes (new hires, promotions, role changes, departures) in sync. 

- Spot where a plan is driving the wrong behavior or is hard to administer, and bring data and a recommendation to the conversation about fixing it. 
 
 Reporting & Insights 

 

- Build dashboards that post-sales leaders actually use: book health, growth initiative pipeline, onboarding and launch timelines, retention and churn risk, and attainment. 

- Field ad hoc data requests from post-sales leaders and turn the repeat ones into self-serve reporting. 
 
 Systems, Processes & AI Automation 

 

- Own how Customer Success, Solutions Engineering and field teams work in Salesforce: account ownership and assignment, handoffs from sales to post-sales, onboarding and go-live tracking, and growth initiatives tied to each account. 

- Design the processes behind that work and build the flows, fields, validation rules and automations that run them. When something breaks, fix the root cause instead of patching the record. 

- Keep account, contract and growth data accurate and trusted, so leaders can run the book of business from Salesforce instead of side spreadsheets. 

- Manage the connected tools post-sales teams depend on (Slack workflows, Google Sheets and BI connectors, enrichment tools) and how they sync with Salesforce. 

- Find the most manual, error-prone parts of all of the above (commission calculations, account assignment, data cleanup, recurring reports) and rebuild them with AI tools and automation. Measure the hours saved and errors removed, and share what works across the GTM team. 
 
 What We're Looking For 

 

- 6+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Success Operations or Business Systems, ideally in a high-growth B2B company. 

- Hands-on Salesforce administration experience (flows, validation rules, reports and dashboards). Admin certification is a plus. 

- Experience owning operations for post-sales teams such as Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions or Implementation. You understand how their work differs from new-logo sales. 

- Experience running commissions and variable compensation administration end to end. 

- Hands-on experience using LLM tools such as Claude Code to automate real workflows. Be ready to walk us through something you built: the problem, the tools, and the result. 

- Expert-level spreadsheet skills (Excel and Google Sheets). 

- Exceptional attention to detail: you verify that a fix actually worked before calling it done, especially when it touches someone's paycheck. 

- Clear, proactive communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leaders. You flag risks early and close the loop. 

- Comfort with ambiguity and a high-growth pace. 

- Must be based in or near San Francisco and able to work in the office at least 2x per week. 
 
 Expected Pay Range: $140,000 - $155,000 per year salaried*

 *The target base salary range for this position is listed above. Individual salaries are determined based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge, skills and experience. 

 Extend does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. 

 Life at Extend: 

 

- Working with a great team from diverse backgrounds in a collaborative and supportive environment. 

- Competitive salary based on experience, with full medical and dental & vision benefits. 

- Stock in an early-stage startup growing quickly. 

- Generous, flexible paid time off policy. 

- 401(k) with Financial Guidance from Morgan Stanley.

title: GTM Revenue Operations Manager
description:
12twenty is the leading platform for employers to connect with elite early career professionals. Our community includes millions of students, recent graduates, and alumni from top business schools, law schools, and universities around the world. We take pride connecting our community of candidates with recruiters from top companies across industries. Come join our fast growing organization! 

 About 12twenty 

 12twenty is a leading career services and early-career recruiting platform connecting universities, students, alumni, and employers. Our technology helps universities manage career services and employer relationships while enabling companies to identify, engage, and recruit emerging talent.

 Our go-to-market organization sells to both sides of that network: universities and schools (our TU business) and employers (our TE business). The two are connected. Our university customer footprint shapes where and how we sell to employers, and our systems need to reflect that relationship. As we scale, we are investing in the systems, data, and automation required to drive pipeline generation and a more predictable revenue engine.

 Position Overview 

 12twenty is seeking a highly analytical, hands-on GTM Revenue Operations Manager to own the systems, integrations, and data infrastructure that power our Marketing, SDR, and Sales teams.

 Salesforce is our single source of truth. HubSpot, Gong, Nooks, and ZoomInfo connect to it, and this role is responsible for making those tools, along with data from the 12twenty product, operate as one system. You will own how prospects move from first engagement through marketing qualification, SDR follow-up, and into the sales pipeline, and how leads and accounts are assigned across a two-sided business with distinct segments and territory rules.

 We do not use a dedicated lead routing tool today. You will build and maintain our routing and assignment logic in Salesforce Flow, and help us decide whether and when a dedicated routing platform is worth adding.

 This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys solving problems, building scalable workflows, and seeing the direct effect of their work on revenue.

 Our GTM Tech Stack 

 

- Salesforce: CRM and system of record 

- HubSpot: marketing automation, synced to Salesforce 

- Nooks: power and parallel dialing, sales engagement 

- ZoomInfo: data enrichment and prospecting 

- Gong: conversation intelligence 

- 12twenty platform: product usage and engagement data, connected to Salesforce and HubSpot 

- SalesNavigator: AE/SDR outbound 
 
 Key Responsibilities 

 GTM Systems Administration and Ownership 

 

- Serve as primary administrator for Salesforce, the system of record for all GTM data, and for HubSpot and its sync to Salesforce. 

- Own the administration and optimization of Nooks, ZoomInfo, and Gong, including their integrations with Salesforce. 

- Evaluate new technologies, including routing, enrichment, and AI-enabled tools such as Clay, and recommend solutions based on cost, adoption, and expected impact. 

- Maintain system documentation, architecture diagrams, workflows, and configuration standards. 
 
 Lead Lifecycle, Routing, and Territory Management 

 

- Own the end-to-end lead lifecycle: capture, deduplication, enrichment, scoring, qualification, and assignment. 

- Establish and maintain lifecycle definitions and MQL criteria across HubSpot and Salesforce. 

- Build and maintain routing and assignment logic in Salesforce Flow, including round-robin, named-account, segment-based, and territory-based rules. 

- Support our territory model in the system: upmarket and downmarket segments defined by employee count, named accounts with caps, a shared account pool, SDR round-robin distribution of pool meetings, and specialized territories such as government. 

- Enforce our rules of engagement in the system, so account ownership, conflicts, and reassignments are handled consistently rather than manually. 

- Model and maintain the relationship between university (TU) customers and employer (TE) accounts in Salesforce, so the TU footprint can inform TE targeting and territory decisions. 

- Route and track leads by source, including Marketing, Product (PLG) leads that flow to the TE team, CX-sourced opportunities handed to Sales, and SDR outbound. 

- Monitor lead flow for dropped, duplicated, delayed, or misrouted leads, find root causes, and fix them. 
 
 Systems Integration and Automation 

 

- Manage the HubSpot and Salesforce integration, including field mapping, sync rules, conflict resolution, and error monitoring. 

- Build and maintain automated workflows that reduce manual work across Marketing, SDR, and Sales, using Salesforce Flow, native connectors, middleware such as Zapier or Workato, and APIs. 

- Maintain the firmographic data (employee count, industry, location) that segment and territory assignment depend on, using ZoomInfo and other enrichment sources. 

- Identify opportunities to apply automation, AI, and enrichment to improve prospecting and SDR efficiency. 

- Connect the 12twenty product to our GTM systems: partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to bring product usage, engagement, and account data into Salesforce and HubSpot. 

- Design and maintain the data model, sync logic, and record matching that tie product users, schools, and employers to the right leads, contacts, and accounts. 

- Put product signals to work in lead scoring, PLG routing, and alerts to Sales, SDR, and CX, so reps can act on in-product activity. 
 
 Funnel Performance, Reporting, and Analytics 

 

- Build and maintain the Salesforce dashboards that feed leadership's recurring KPI reviews. 

- Report on the full funnel by business (TE and TU) and by lead source: MQLs, meetings booked and completed, SQOs, pipeline, average selling price, and days to close. 

- Include product usage and engagement signals in funnel and account reporting, such as PLG user conversion, activity by customer, and usage trends that point to expansion or renewal risk. 

- Monitor speed-to-lead, SDR follow-up activity, and adherence to MQL-to-SDR service-level agreements set with Marketing and SDR leadership. 

- Track sales engagement and activity metrics in Nooks and Salesforce to identify ways to improve SDR productivity. 

- Recommend improvements based on trends and conversion data. 
 
 Data Quality and Governance 

 

- Set and maintain data hygiene standards across Salesforce, HubSpot, and connected tools, including deduplication, validation, and enrichment. 

- Keep field definitions, lifecycle stages, account ownership, and reporting structures consistent. 

- Treat Salesforce data from January 2025 forward as the reporting baseline, and clean up or archive older records as needed. 

- Monitor system health and integration errors, and document governance standards. 
 
 Cross-Functional Partnership 

 

- Work with Marketing, SDR, Sales, and Solution Consulting leadership to translate business requirements into system changes. 

- Manage and prioritize incoming system requests, balancing immediate needs with long-term scalability. 

- Communicate system changes, train users, and drive adoption of new processes. 
 
 Scope of the Role 

 This role owns GTM systems, data, routing, automation, and funnel reporting. Territory design, quota setting, compensation plans, and forecasting methodology are owned by Revenue leadership; this role builds and maintains the systems and reporting that support those decisions.

 Your First 90 Days 

 

- Learn our two-sided business, our segments, and how leads and accounts move through the funnel today. 

- Audit and harden the round-robin, account pool, and rules-of-engagement logic supporting our 2027 territory structure. 

- Clean up account ownership and resolve assignment gaps following the territory changes.

 Qualifications and Experience 

 Required 

 

- 3 to 5+ years in Revenue Operations, Marketing Operations, Sales Operations, or a similar systems-focused role. 

- Advanced Salesforce administration experience, including configuration, Flow, reporting, and dashboards. 

- Experience building lead routing and assignment logic in Salesforce Flow (round-robin, territory, or account-based), with or without a dedicated routing tool. 

- Hands-on HubSpot experience, including workflows, lead scoring, lifecycle management, and the Salesforce integration. 

- Experience administering sales engagement and dialing platforms (Nooks or similar) and data enrichment tools (ZoomInfo or similar). 

- Working knowledge of APIs, webhooks, and integration platforms such as Zapier or Workato. 

- Experience integrating product or application usage data into a CRM or marketing automation platform, in partnership with engineering or data teams. 

- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. 
 
 Preferred 

 

- Salesforce Administrator certification. 

- Experience with tools such as Gong, Clay, LeanData, Chili Piper, Outreach, Salesloft, or Apollo. 

- Experience supporting a SaaS business with multiple segments, products, or buyer types. 

- Experience implementing territory models, named accounts, or rules of engagement in Salesforce. 

- Experience with SQL or other tools for advanced reporting and data management. 

- Experience with data warehouses, customer data platforms, or reverse ETL tools such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Segment, Census, or Hightouch. 

- Exposure to AI-enabled GTM workflows. 
 
 What Success Looks Like

- Speed-to-lead: MQL-to-first-touch times meet the service-level agreements set with Marketing and SDR leadership.

- Funnel visibility: TE and TU funnel reporting by lead source is current and used in leadership reviews. 

- Product data in the CRM: product usage and engagement data from the 12twenty platform is available in Salesforce and HubSpot and used in lead scoring, PLG routing, and account prioritization. 

- Less manual work: fewer manual assignment, data-entry, and sync-fix tasks for Sales, SDR, and Marketing. 

- Scalable systems: documented, well-governed systems that support growth without rework. 
 
 Ideal Candidate Profile 

 We are looking for a systems thinker who is also a hands-on operator. You are curious about how systems connect, quick to spot where processes break, and motivated by building solutions that make the whole revenue team more effective.

 You understand how technology supports revenue, not only how to configure it. You work independently, manage competing priorities, and bring structure to a GTM environment that is still evolving.

 We want someone who can own the systems and processes behind our revenue engine, so that the right data reaches the right people at the right time.

title: Senior Revenue Operations (RevOps) Manager
description:
About Us 

 Qualio is on a mission to empower life science teams to launch and scale life-saving products. We’re doing that by building a connected and integrated quality management platform for the entire life science ecosystem. Qualio is trusted by over 600 highly regulated international customers, ranging from the bleeding edge of computational biology and machine learning to household names in mRNA vaccine development. 

 The Qualio team is all-remote, and currently distributed across North America, Europe and Australia.

 What’s the opportunity? 

 We are looking for a Sr. Revenue Operations Manager to help manage processes, systems, data, and AI-enabled workflows for the revenue functions of Qualio (Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success). 

This is an individual contributor role where you will maintain the systems for the revenue functions, drive efficiency through automation and AI, and ensure data integrity across systems. To be successful, you should have experience in the same or a similar role, deep experience with GTM processes and systems, and curiosity about how AI and automation can change how revenue teams work. You should also demonstrate leadership skills and be able to work with and influence others across the organization. Ultimately, you will help the GTM teams be more productive and keep all revenue functions in line with the company’s strategic goals.

 There is room to grow here. This role sits on the RevOps team and can develop toward GTM engineering as your skills in integrations, automation, and AI agents deepen.

 What will I be doing? 

 

- Manage and optimize the revenue technology stack, including Salesforce, Gong, HubSpot, Nooks, DealHub, and other tools, with clean object and field design, sound permissions, and documented integrations 

- Evaluate new tools against real workflow needs, own rollout and enablement, and retire tools and fields that are no longer useful 

- Build and maintain automations, integrations, and AI agents that remove manual work and surface deal context and account signals inside the tools the field already uses 

- Validate AI outputs against source systems before they reach the field or leadership, and document the guardrails so others can trust them 

- Assist Revenue leadership in building, documenting, and improving business processes, and encode them in the systems through validation rules, routing, and automation rather than tribal knowledge

- Monitor daily operations and address issues as they arise 
 
 What skills do I need? 

 

- 5-7 years of experience in Revenue Operations 

- Experience with Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) business models, with an understanding of recurring revenue dynamics 

- Salesforce administration experience and ideally a certified administrator 

- Experience with Gong, Omni, HubSpot and DealHub ideally 

- Hands-on experience using AI tools and automation platforms (such as Claude, Make, or Zapier) to streamline workflows, and the judgment to validate AI outputs against source data 

- Interest in growing toward GTM engineering, with a working knowledge of or appetite to learn APIs, integrations, and data models 

- Strong quantitative skills and the willingness to dig into data 

- Exceptional communication and collaboration skills 

- Ability to develop and maintain effective relationships with key stakeholders 
 
 Benefits 

 

- The opportunity in helping life-saving products get to market faster 

- Medical coverage (with premiums for our most popular plan fully covered for you and your eligible dependents) 

- Dental and Vision coverage 

- 401(k) with up to 4% company matching 

- Dependent Care & Health FSA, HSA, Short/Long Term Disability, Basic & Voluntary Life Insurance 

- 12+ weeks of Paid Parental Leave 

- Flexible Time Off (FTO) policy - take time when you need it

- Annual Learning & Development stipend 

- Regular team gatherings and all-org meetups

 Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply for jobs unless they believe they meet every single one of the qualifications as described in a job description.
