That candidate may be one who comes from a less traditional background, and that’s okay. We would strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don't believe you meet every one of the qualifications described.

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
Who We Are 

 Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

 Is this identity synthetic? Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.
 Is this identity risky? Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.
 Is this identity known? Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

 Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

 Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

 Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

 What you’ll do

 Pindrop is looking for a Revenue Operations Manager to help our go-to-market (GTM) teams plan smarter, forecast with confidence, and sell more efficiently.

 Reporting to the Director, Revenue Operations, you'll be the analytical and operational partner behind RevOps initiatives across GTM planning, forecasting, compensation, systems, and partner operations. You'll work with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Partnerships, Deal Desk, and Finance to gather the data, uncover what's working and what isn't, and bring the analysis that informs the department’s decisions. You'll support initiatives from discovery and analysis through design, build, and enablement.

 This is a Manager-level individual contributor role. As you build expertise in our business, your impact will grow, from improving the data and reporting our teams rely on every day to shaping the analysis behind key GTM decisions.

 We’re looking for someone who brings three strengths: the drive to find what’s slowing our teams down and build better processes to fix it, the ability to build trusted relationships with the teams RevOps supports, and strong analytical skills that turn data into clear recommendations.

 GTM Planning, Capacity, and Compensation 

 

- Partner with cross-functional teams on annual and in-year GTM planning, building the processes and running the analysis behind territory design, books of business, account scoring, segmentation, and pipeline modeling 

- Deliver analyses that inform our headcount and capacity models, including rep ramp, productivity, and coverage assumptions, and create the executive dashboards that show where we have capacity gaps and need to hire 

- Own day-to-day sales compensation administration, including plan documents, new-hire setup, attainment tracking, and payout support 

- Provide the attainment and productivity analysis that informs compensation plan design, quota methodology, and rules of engagement 
 
 Forecasting, Pipeline, and Performance Insights 

 

- Own data preparation, meeting materials, and follow-up for weekly forecast and pipeline reviews 

- Own forecast data quality for net-new and renewal business, identifying and driving cleanup with sales managers, and help develop clear rules for pushing or closing deals 

- Own the reporting and dashboards that reps, managers, BDRs, and executives use to run the business, and deliver analyses on funnel conversion, velocity, attribution, and productivity 

- Help develop and maintain standard definitions for core GTM metrics and objects, such as customer, pipeline stages, and ARR, so every team works from the same numbers 
 
 Systems, Process, and Partner Operations 

 

- Proactively identify process gaps and issues across the GTM lifecycle, and develop solutions to correct them, including the system requirements, user experience, and plan for maintaining the data 

- Own Salesforce data quality, and help design and implement improvements across the sales cycle, including stage gates, lead routing, approvals, and Deal Desk workflows 

- Support partner operations across referral, reseller, marketplace, and alliance motions, including deal registration, approval processes, partner attribution, and field enablement on partner types 

- Build trusted relationships with GTM leaders and their teams, representing RevOps in working sessions and bringing the feedback and data that help the Director prioritize RevOps initiatives 

- Support GTM tool and vendor management, RevOps request intake, and the rollout and enablement of new tools and processes, including analysis for new tool and process investments 

- Work with Deal Desk, Legal, and Customer Success on process improvements that shorten the path from quote to close 
 
 Who you are

 

- You take ownership and do the things you say you'll do 

- You dig into the data, spot what doesn't add up, and come back with a recommendation, not just a report 

- You enjoy building processes and infrastructure from the ground up, not just maintaining what already exists 

- You think about how a change lands with the reps, managers, and partners who have to live with it 

- You manage multiple projects at once and prioritize by business impact 

- You use AI responsibly to improve processes and work more efficiently, and you take full ownership of the final output 
 
 Your skill-set

 

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred 

- 3-5+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Sales Strategy, or GTM Analytics, preferably at a high-growth B2B SaaS company 

- Admin-level Salesforce experience, including reports and dashboards, objects and fields, validation rules, and Flows (Salesforce Administrator certification a plus) 

- Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, including the analysis and modeling that support planning, capacity, or compensation decisions 

- Working knowledge of SaaS metrics and the B2B sales cycle, including pipeline coverage, conversion rates, ramp, attainment, ARR, and retention 

- Experience with Gong, Outreach or Salesloft, LeanData, Gainsight, Highspot, Coefficient, DocuSign, Unifyr, or Tackle.io is a plus 

- Experience with SQL, BI/visualization tools, or data warehouses such as Databricks or Snowflake is a plus 
 
 What’s in it for you

 

- Build the foundation, not just maintain it. RevOps at Pindrop has high-impact work ahead in planning, forecasting, compensation, and partner operations, and you'll help decide how it gets done. 

- See how a scaling revenue organization is run. You'll work directly with the Director of Revenue Operations and alongside Sales, Customer Success, Partnerships, and Finance leaders, with visibility into how GTM decisions get made. 

- Support a business with real market urgency. AI-driven fraud and deepfakes are now a board-level concern for large enterprises, and your work will help the teams bringing Pindrop into those conversations operate at their best. 

- Work inside an AI-first organization. Pindrop is investing in AI across the business, and you’ll use AI to automate reporting, data cleanup, and systems work, and help define what an AI-enabled RevOps team looks like. 

- Grow your impact. As you build expertise, you’ll have more opportunities to shape how our GTM teams plan, forecast, and operate. 
 
 What we offer

 As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

 

- Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) 

- Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year, subject to manager approval and applicable company policies. 

- Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year 

- Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success. 

- While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success. 

- Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid “employee-only” plan! 

- Best-in-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution 

- Low-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind. 

- Paid Parental Leave - Including birth, adoptive & foster parents 
 

- One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It’s our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family! 
 

- Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work. 

- Enhanced fertility and GLP-1 benefits to support family-building journeys and personalized health needs. 

- Annual Learning & Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill-building, certifications, and continued education. 
 
 #LI-Remote 

 Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Pindrop considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills, as well as market and business considerations, when extending an offer.

 US Base Pay Range $100,000 — $125,000 USD Not sure if this is you? 

 We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

 AI - A Transformative Force 

 At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

 Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed.

 Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer 

 Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.

title: RevOps Data Infrastructure Engineer (LatAm, Remote)
description:
About the company 

 AltiSales is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, technology, and operations of Sales and Sales Development. AltiSales lives in the intersection of 3 industries: Software (www.gtmcaddy.io), Consulting & Outsourcing, and Venture Capital. We work with clients to create a sustainable and scalable revenue engine that can later be brought in-house as the teams grow from a few BDEs to dozens of them.

 AltiSales was founded in 2012 by Tito Bohrt, who is a well recognized LinkedIn influencer in Business Development and who advocates for strategic & thoughtful outbound, rather than spray & pray. Tito has hired and trained over 200 SDRs including some of the best performers at public companies like Citrix. Today Tito leads AltiSales and writes articles for Sales Hacker, Forbes, and his personal blog on LinkedIn.

 Our Core Values are: 

 

- Excellence and Thoughtfulness: We understand that excellence is contagious and inspire others with our thirst for it. Excellence is about thoughtfulness, quality of our work outputs, and the outcomes we deliver, not about the volume of work we produce or the hours we work. The speed and volume of work must be combined with extreme attention to detail and thoughtfulness to be valuable. Sloppy AI-generated work is frowned upon. We hate mediocrity and excuses. 

- Company > Team > Individual: We seek what is best for our clients and our company, rather than what's best for ourselves or our group, even when that means closing the vault. We are ego-less in the search for the best ideas. We help others and share information openly. 

- Ownership and Accountability: We behave like owners. We never wait to be told what to do, or act like "it's not our job" to do more. We own every mistake made by our direct reports and our AI outputs. We act like leaders, always self-motivating, self-improving and self-disciplined. We make tough decisions without agonizing. We question actions inconsistent with our values. 

- Common Sense: We believe that excessive rules make our company less agile and adaptable in a constantly changing world, and therefore we prioritize common sense. We use company resources with common sense and adapt to rapidly changing markets. 

- Team, Not Family: We behave as a professional sports team. We want the best player in every position and try to hire, develop, and cut smartly, to optimize team performance. 

- Customer Centricity: We strive to make every customer successful, because their success is our success. Empathy is our default. We work hard to augment our clients growth day-in and day-out. We pride ourselves on making a tangible impact on our customers' lives and businesses. 
 
 Our Benefits: 

 

- Attractive Compensation Package: We offer a competitive salary, commission, and bonuses in USD, which include performance-based salary increases. Join our prestigious Presidents Club: Achieve your revenue targets and every quarter, we reward you with an exciting trip to destinations like Vegas, Mexico, and Costa Rica. While on these trips, you'll have the opportunity to bond with the team and engage in thrilling activities such as scuba diving, whitewater rafting, and bungee jumping. As a top performer, you'll be celebrated and receive well-deserved recognition. 

- Remote-First Culture: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere that suits you best. Our company fully supports remote work, allowing you to choose your ideal location. We go the extra mile by covering your coworking space expenses and providing all the necessary equipment you need to excel in your role. 

- Work-Life Balance: Enjoy our open vacation policy that allows you to take time off whenever you need it, as long as you continue to meet your goals. We understand the importance of a healthy work-life balance and trust our employees to manage their time effectively. 

- Unlimited Professional Growth: Fuel your expertise with our unlimited professional development budget. We cover 100% of the costs for books, courses, conferences, and any other opportunities to enhance your skills. 

- Additional Exciting Perks: We offer a range of cool benefits including health reimbursement, fitness stipend, and more. 
 
 About the role 

 As a Data Infrastructure Engineer, you will join our Revenue Operations team. We manage sales data for multiple B2B clients, each with its own CRM and sales engagement platform. Your job is to turn all of that into one reliable, scalable data platform that powers reporting, automation and decision-making across the company.

 You'll own the data warehouse, the pipelines that feed it, and the data layer behind the dashboards and alerts our teams rely on every day. When something works for one client, you make it work for all of them.

 We are AI-first: we use AI every day to build faster, and we own its outputs by checking the logic of every piece before moving on. Documentation is part of the job, and a project is only done when people are using it.

 Responsibilities: 

 

- Data Warehouse: Own and evolve our cloud data warehouse and data models. 

- Data Pipelines: Build, run and monitor ingestion pipelines from CRMs, sales engagement platforms and other sources, including sources without native connectors. 

- Process Automation: Replace fragile spreadsheet-based processes with scalable, warehouse-based solutions. 

- Reporting & Alerts: Build and maintain the data layer behind dashboards, reports, automated notifications and alerts. 

- Data Quality: Monitor data integrity, catch issues early and fix them at the source. 

- Scalability: Turn proven one-off solutions into standardized processes that work for every client, and manage access, cost and performance of the data stack. 

- Documentation: Write clear technical documentation and guidelines. 
 
 Required Qualifications: 

 

- Bilingual English proficiency, written and spoken. Interviews are conducted in English. 

- 3+ years of proven experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or a technical RevOps / BizOps role. 

- Strong SQL and hands-on experience with a cloud data warehouse (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift). 

- Experience with data modeling tools (e.g., Dataform, dbt) and ELT tools (e.g., Fivetran), including troubleshooting broken pipelines. 

- Scripting experience (e.g., JavaScript / Google Apps Script or Python). 

- Good understanding of CRM and sales data (HubSpot and Salesforce are the most important). 

- High standards for data quality: you check your numbers before anyone else sees them. 

- Based in Latin America, with good overlap with US business hours. 
 
 Desirable Qualifications (Nice to Have): 

 

- Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce or Outreach data and APIs. 

- Experience with Google Cloud Platform and BI tools (e.g., Looker Studio). 

- Git and version control. 

- Experience migrating spreadsheet-based processes to a data warehouse. 

- Daily use of AI tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Copilot) to build faster. 
 
 Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language. 

 AltiSales is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status.

title: Data Foundations, GTM Systems
location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY; Seattle, WA
description:
About Anthropic 

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

 About the role

 Anthropic's go-to-market teams are scaling quickly, and the decisions they make, from who to sell to and how to cover them to where to invest next, are only as good as the intelligence and infrastructure underneath them. As a Data Engineer on the GTM Systems data foundations team, you'll help build that layer: the data products that give sellers, operators, and analysts a rich, current, and trusted picture of the market, and the engineering rigor that lets our GTM systems run reliably as the business grows.

 This is an engineering role that goes beyond pipelines. You'll treat GTM data as a product and a platform: built once, kept current, and available wherever people work. Alongside the build, you'll help shape what the data means: how attributes are defined, which sources are trusted, and how the business puts them to use. The role sits at the intersection of the sales organization, the data organization, and the systems that data flows through. You'll partner closely with Sales Strategy and Operations, Finance, Data Science, and the central data engineering team.

 Key responsibilities

 

- 
 Bring disparate internal and external sources together: orchestrate, model, and normalize first-party product and revenue data alongside third-party data into one usable understanding of the company landscape

 

- 
 Build and maintain identity and entity resolution, so every source attaches to one trusted record for each company and the relationships between companies are clear

 

- 
 Help build the canonical layer where key attributes are defined once and mean the same thing everywhere, with clear sourcing logic, provenance, and freshness

 

- 
 Turn data into intelligence: scores, signals, and AI-generated attributes that help GTM teams prioritize and act, held to the same quality bar as any other source

 

- 
 Deliver that intelligence to the surfaces where teams work, including the CRM, and bring production discipline to how data moves through those systems

 

- 
 Operate what you build as a living system, with observability, data quality, cost, security, and access controls designed in, so problems surface before the field sees them

 

- 
 Partner with the owners of GTM processes such as planning, segmentation, and routing to settle definitions, make clear commitments, and communicate tradeoffs

 

- 
 Make the platform easy for other teams to build on, so work is contributed once and not rebuilt in silos

 
 
 Minimum qualifications

 

- 
 Experience as a data engineer or analytics engineer building and operating production pipelines and data models

 

- 
 Strong SQL and Python, and experience with modern transformation and orchestration tooling on a cloud data warehouse

 

- 
 Experience making messy data from many sources usable, including record matching, deduplication, and reconciling conflicting values

 

- 
 Familiarity with go-to-market data and the CRM systems it flows through

 

- 
 Judgment beyond the pipeline: weighing data sources, shaping definitions with business partners, and making calls on data quality

 

- 
 Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical partners

 

- 
 Regular hands-on use of AI tools in your engineering work

 
 
 Preferred qualifications

 

- 
 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or GTM data roles

 

- 
 Experience building a shared data product or platform that several teams depend on and contribute to

 

- 
 Experience with company data such as firmographics, corporate hierarchies, or master data management

 

- 
 Experience using LLMs inside data pipelines and evaluating their output

 

- 
 Hands-on Salesforce experience, including working at large data volumes

 

- 
 Experience supporting GTM planning processes such as territory design, segmentation, or scoring

 
 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

 Annual Salary: $270,000 — $345,000 USD Logistics 

 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

 For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

 How we're different 

 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

 Come work with us! 

 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Senior Revenue Systems Specialist
description:
Greenhouse is the first Orchestrated Hiring Ecosystem: a single place that brings the right person and the right role together at the right time. Our mission is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse, you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.

 Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

 Greenhouse is looking for a Senior Revenue Systems Specialist to join our team!

 Revenue Systems owns the go-to-market technology stack at Greenhouse, from first outreach through renewal. As a Senior Revenue Systems Specialist, you’ll own systems work across both pre-sale and post-sale: Salesforce, our sales system of record, and the platforms our Customer Success and Customer Marketing teams work from every day, currently Gainsight and Accord. Breadth is a key aspect of this role, and you’ll have real latitude to shape where the stack goes next.

 Who will love this job 

 

- A systems generalist - you enjoy working across a stack rather than being confined to one corner of it, and you’re comfortable moving to where the work is 

- A solutions-oriented partner - you can hear what the business is trying to accomplish and turn it into something that works, and you stay with a problem until the desired outcome is achieved 

- A curious builder - you want to understand why a process exists before you automate it, and you’re comfortable saying when something doesn’t seem to make sense, including to the people asking for it 

- An owner - you take a project from first conversation through rollout and adoption without needing it project-managed for you 

- An AI-fluent operator - you already use tools like Claude, Glean, or ChatGPT in your day to day, and you’re interested in what they can do inside a revenue stack 
 
 What you’ll do 

 

- Own and build solutions in Salesforce, including data model design, declarative automation, validation, permissions, page layouts, and reporting, taking projects from scoping and intake through rollout, adoption, and documentation 

- Administer our post-sale platforms, including Gainsight and Accord, alongside our Customer Success Operations team, covering the rules engine, journey and email programs, surveys including NPS, and the workflows behind customer health scoring, CSM assignment, and account transfers 

- Own integrations between Salesforce, Gainsight, and the rest of the stack, standing up new ones independently and eliminating the recurring failures that come with the existing ones 

- Partner with Sales, Customer Success, and Customer Marketing on their requests, working out whether the fix belongs in a system or somewhere else, and seeing it through to a working solution either way 

- Lead platform migration and consolidation work as our tech stack changes, from evaluation and vendor assessment through data movement, cutover, and adoption 

- Hold a point of view on where the stack should go, surfacing the opportunities and the risks in our implementation rather than waiting to be asked 

- Document what you build, and bring request volume down over time through automation and self-service 

- Additional projects and responsibilities as business needs require 
 
 You should have 

 

- Several years in revenue operations, customer success operations, business systems, or platform administration. 

- B2B SaaS experience. 

- Deep hands-on Salesforce administration experience: data model design, declarative automation, permissions and sharing, reporting, and the judgment to know when not to build. You should be comfortable making medium to large changes to a production org and reasoning about the performance and scale implications of your configuration choices. 

- Hands-on ownership of Gainsight or a comparable post-sale platform (e.g., Totango, ChurnZero, Planhat), with enough depth to configure independently and to hold a credible view on whether the platform is serving the business. 

- Experience standing up integrations without support, and a record of eliminating recurring failures rather than only resolving them. 

- Experience owning a platform migration or consolidation end to end, including the data movement. 

- A track record of taking a problem from the first report through to a working solution. 

- Comfort operating as the most knowledgeable person in the room on a platform, and the instinct to bring others along rather than becoming the only one who can do the work. 

- Clear writing. A real part of this job is explaining to a non-technical stakeholder what you built and how to use it, or what went wrong and what you did about it. 

- Experience across more than one post-sale platform is a plus. So is exposure to Salesforce CPQ, enrichment tooling like Clay, or building with MCP and agentic tooling against enterprise systems. 

- Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of transferable skills that aren’t always in alignment with a given role, but those are qualities we value at Greenhouse. If you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply. 
 
 Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. 

 If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents linked here . 

 The national pay range for this role is $88,100.00 - $127,700.00. Individual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate's experience and qualifications. Certain roles may be eligible for additional compensation, including stock option awards, bonuses, and merit increases. Additionally, certain roles have the opportunity to receive sales commissions that are based on the terms of the sales commission plan applicable to the role. 

 Greenhouse provides a variety of benefits to employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, basic life insurance, mental health resources, financial wellness benefits, and a fully paid parental leave program. For US-based employees, we offer short-term and long-term disability coverage, a 401(k) plan and company match. U.S. based employees also receive, per calendar year, up to 14 scheduled paid holidays and up to 80 hours of paid sick leave. Non-exempt employees accrue up to 20-25 days of paid vacation time annually, depending on tenure, and exempt employees have flexible paid time off (PTO). 

 The anticipated closing date for this role is December 18th, 2026 . 

 #LI-SS1 

 Who we are 

 At Greenhouse, we live by our mission through using our own product to help us hire the right person for the job, every time. We’re committed to designing and responsibly using AI tools to transform how we work while keeping people at the center. We are a remote-first company and have shared office spaces in New York City and Ireland, and optional co-working spaces that give us flexibility to do our best work anywhere. We take an active role in our growth through a performance review program that’s committed to providing actionable feedback, and a bonus structure that rewards great performance. We believe that bringing together a variety of perspectives makes us a stronger company – and we nurture leaders who create an inclusive culture and invest into employee resource groups that celebrate our differences and life experiences. We’re proud to have built an award-winning culture that’s been recognized as Fortune’s Best Places to Work and Inc.’s Best Workplaces multiple years in a row. 

 – 

 Greenhouse Software is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, reach out to accommodations@greenhouse.io. 

 Emails about job opportunities at Greenhouse Software are only offered by employees with @greenhouse.io email addresses. See this page on our website if you suspect a phishing scam.

description:
About Glean: 
 
 Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. 
 
 At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. 
 
 Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. 
 
 If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. 
 About the Role: 
 
 Glean is seeking a Salesforce Developer to design, develop, and continuously improve our Salesforce platform and its ecosystem of integrations. You will partner closely with Sales, Finance, Operations, and Engineering to build scalable, secure, and reliable solutions that support the full quote-to-cash and go-to-market lifecycle. 
 This role is ideal for an experienced hands-on developer who can translate complex business requirements into maintainable Salesforce solutions, independently own technical delivery, and help establish strong engineering, testing, and release practices as Glean scales. 
 
 You will: 
 
 

- Drive the technical implementation of Salesforce enhancements, from technical design and development through testing, deployment support, documentation, and post-release issue resolution. 

- Design and develop scalable solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Flow, validation rules, asynchronous processing, and platform automation. 

- Build and maintain integrations between Salesforce and internal and third-party systems using REST/SOAP APIs, platform events, middleware, and integration patterns appropriate to the use case. 

- Contribute to the evolution of Salesforce as the system of record for opportunity, quote, order, customer, and other go-to-market data. 

- Support quote-to-cash capabilities, including Revenue Cloud or CPQ-related processes, product and pricing workflows, order management, approvals, and downstream fulfillment integrations. 

- Translate business requirements into clear technical designs, data models, user experiences, and implementation plans. 

- Establish and maintain high standards for code quality, test coverage, security, performance, observability, and long-term maintainability. 

- Follow and contribute to deployment and release practices across environments, including source control, CI/CD, code reviews, release planning, and rollback readiness. 

- Investigate production issues, lead root-cause analysis, and implement durable fixes that prevent recurrence. 

- Partner with administrators, analysts, architects, and business stakeholders to balance speed, usability, technical debt, and platform governance. 

- Contribute to Salesforce architecture, integration standards, documentation, and operating procedures as the platform and team grow. 

- Collaborate with administrators, developers, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable solutions and continuously improve the platform. 
 
 
 About you: 
 
 

- 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including ownership of complex implementations in a fast-growing or enterprise environment. 

- Strong proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components, Salesforce Flow, SOQL/SOSL, asynchronous Apex, and Salesforce platform capabilities. 

- Experience designing and implementing integrations using REST and SOAP APIs, authentication patterns, middleware, platform events, or comparable event-driven approaches. 

- Strong understanding of Salesforce data modeling, sharing and security, governor limits, bulkification, performance optimization, and enterprise architecture principles. 

- Experience with Sales Cloud and at least one of Revenue Cloud, CPQ, order management, billing, or other quote-to-cash capabilities. 

- Experience with Salesforce DevOps practices, source-driven development, Git, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and structured release management. 

- Demonstrated ability to convert ambiguous business problems into practical, scalable technical solutions. 

- Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders across multiple functions. 

- A track record of taking ownership, exercising sound judgment, and delivering reliable solutions in a changing environment. 

- Experience working in an Agile delivery environment, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and independently driving technical delivery. 

- Salesforce Platform Developer I and II certifications are preferred; additional architecture, integration, or Revenue Cloud certifications are a plus. 

- An AI-first mindset and curiosity about using AI-enabled tools to improve analysis, development productivity, testing, documentation, and operational workflows. 
 
 
 
 Location: 
 
 

- This role is hybrid (3 days a week in our Bangalore office). 
 
 
 Compensation & Benefits: 
 
 Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. 
 
 We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long-term goals. title: MBA Full-Time Hire - Sales Strategy & Operations
description:
Who We Are 

 Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

 We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

 You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

 About the Role 

 As a member of our Sales Strategy and Operations team, you will have an integral role in driving the insights, operations, and strategy that enables Sales to run better, faster, and smarter. Sales Strategy and Operations is an excellent platform to learn how a business really runs. Prior candidates that our leadership team has worked with have gone on to be VPs and COOs of companies.

 You will be joining the Sales Strategy and Operations team as a high impact contributor, gaining exposure to a wide variety of challenges, processes, and data that makes the engine of this Sales organization hum. As a Manager on the team, you will lead cross-functional initiatives from ideation to analytics to recommendations to drive impact across the sales organization.

 What You'll Do 

 

- Strategy & planning: pulling ongoing and ad hoc reporting for weekly / quarterly business reviews, and providing insights to inform business decisions. 

- Systems and operations: identifying and implementing improvements in current workflows and processes that can help improve efficiency and visibility - this might be in Salesforce.com or other tools. 

- Sales Enablement: building programming and content to help new hires get up to speed as quickly as possible, as well as tracking the right effectiveness metrics to see what makes someone a top (or bottom) performer and how we scale those learnings. 

- In a fast-scaling environment like ours, there's a lot of rolling up your sleeves and getting into the weeds to drive direct impact on a daily basis. We knock out today's problems while also balancing our need to build for the long-term. 

- You’ll be working in Salesforce and Google Sheets / Excel on a daily basis, while also talking frequently with our stakeholders in sales, marketing, ops, product, finance, and more to help troubleshoot systems issues, review insights from our analyses, and build future-state processes and systems. 
 
 What You Bring 

 

- High-impact self-starter: you take initiative to move projects forward and can operate well with little guidance. 

- Raw smarts: we are looking for people with strong business acumen who can approach complex problems and solve them from start to finish. 

- Excellent analytics skills: you have a data-driven mentality; you are excited to dig through data to drive evidence-based discussions and decision-making. Excel / Google Sheets skills are a must; SQL / Tableau / Looker experience is a plus. 

- High attention to detail: at Verkada, we pride ourselves on first principles thinking and sweating the details as the keys to business results. You should excel in these areas and set a standard for others. 

- Communication and stakeholder management: you'll need to be able to connect with sales reps and hardware engineers alike to build scalable processes. Strong written and verbal communication skills are a must. 

- Flexibility and hustle: you are comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment that will require you to manage competing priorities and continually adapt to change as the company scales. 

- Prior experience in high impact functions: 5+ years of professional experience, ideally in consulting, banking, private equity, corporate strategy, or a startup. Previous sales, sales operations, or strategy experience is a plus. 

- Bachelors or masters from a top school preferred. Must be graduating from an accredited MBA program in 2027. 

- Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week. 
 
 US Employee Benefits 

 
 Verkada is committed to fostering a workplace environment that prioritizes the holistic health and wellbeing of our employees and their families by offering comprehensive wellness perks, benefits, and resources. Our benefits and perks programs include, but are not limited to:

 

- Healthcare programs that can be tailored to meet the personal health and financial well-being needs - Premiums are 100% covered for the employee under at least one plan and 80% for family premiums under all plans 

- Nationwide medical, vision and dental coverage 

- Starting January 2027, Verkada will match a portion of an employee’s 401(k) contributions based on eligible earnings. Match vests on 2 year anniversary 

- Health Saving Account (HSA) with annual employer contributions and Flexible Spending Account (FSA) with tax saving options 

- Expanded mental health support 

- Paid parental leave policy & fertility benefits 

- Time off to relax and recharge through our paid holidays, firmwide extended holidays, flexible PTO and personal sick time 

- Professional development stipend 

- Wellness/fitness benefits 

- Healthy lunches provided daily 

- Commuter benefits 
 
 
 Additional Information 

 

- We do sponsor and take over sponsorship of employment visas for this role. If we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa. 
 Annual Pay Range 

 At Verkada, we want to attract and retain the best employees, and compensate them in a way that appropriately and fairly values their individual contribution to the company. With that in mind, we carefully consider a number of factors to determine the appropriate starting pay for an employee, including their primary work location and an assessment of a candidate's skills and experience, as well as market demands and internal parity. A Verkada employee may be eligible for additional forms of compensation, depending on their role, including sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and/or equity in the company in the form of restricted stock units (RSUs)

 Below is the annual on-target earnings (OTE) range for full-time employees for this position, comprised of base compensation and commissions (if applicable).

 Estimated Annual Pay Range $165,000 — $205,000 USD Verkada Is An Equal Opportunity Employer 

 As an equal opportunity employer, Verkada is committed to providing employment opportunities to all individuals. All applicants for positions at Verkada will be treated without regard to race, color, ethnicity, religion, sex, gender, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law.

 Your application will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy .

title: AMER Data Analyst - Sales Strategy and Operations
location: Chicago, US Remote, SF, NYC, Seattle
description:
Who we are 

 About Stripe 

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

 About the team 

 The Sales Strategy & Operations team is responsible for the overall productivity and effectiveness of the sales organization, partnering closely with the sales team and other teams across Stripe to drive highly strategic initiatives. This team is integral in the success of our sales organization. With a commitment to excellence and a deep understanding of the art and science of sales, our team is dedicated to informing the sales strategy, optimising processes, and providing insights that propel our sales growth. We do this by being objective, trusted partners to the Sales Leadership team.

 What you’ll do 

 We are seeking a technically sophisticated and detail oriented individual who will serve as a Sales Strategy and Operations Data Analyst in support of the AMER Velocity (Commercial and SMB) business. This person will be responsible for improving the quality of sales analytics and insights, including standardization of reporting and scalability with the primary objective of enabling sales leadership to make effective, analytically driven decisions. You will work primarily with Sales Leadership and other cross-functional business partners to drive the operational cadence and strategy/planning of the business.

 Responsibilities 

 

- Operating Cadence: Execute on a standard weekly, monthly and quarterly cadence of operations (weekly forecasting calls, monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews). 

- Business Insights: Develop a deep understanding of the Velocity business and its sales funnel. Provide actionable insights and a strategic perspective on business performance to help inform key decisions. Effectively communicate insights and recommendations to business leads and influence strategic decision-making. 

- Strategy / Planning: Analyze sales and revenue data and other metrics to build models and provide actionable recommendations to shape the strategy during the annual planning process (resource planning, territory design, target/quota setting and management). 

- Program and Process Management: Independently develop and manage project or program plans to support requests from key stakeholder and core operational planning processes. Manage segment wide operational processes and programs including but not limited to sales territory development. 

- Scalable Insight: Conceptualize, build, manage and maintain centralized tools (including spreadsheet models, dashboards) that the business and Sales Strategy & Operations team can use to extract data / insights for daily business management in an automated manner to drive current and future rhythms of business. As a result of insights, identify and improve the usability and accessibility of insights from existing systems and tools, in collaboration with respective development teams. 
 
 Who you are 

 We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 

 Minimum requirements 

 

- 3–5 years of work experience in B2B sales strategy and operations and/or business analytics, business strategy/operations, data science, investment banking, management consulting, and/or related domains. 

- Strong analytical skills, business intuition and a structured approach to solving complex business problems. 

- User-first mindset: Ability to work proactively and collaboratively with stakeholders, particularly in clearly communicating data insights and takeaways. 

- Has an enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality. Pragmatic problem solver, with a bias to action and “getting things done”. Passionate about driving business outcomes and change at the ground level.

We are a partnering team and aim to work cross functionally to support our internal functions successfully in a consumption business. This is a new team, so you will be building the way we work, and we expect successful candidates to use AI every day to take on more than a team this size normally could. 

 About the Role 

 You will turn the Consumption strategy into working models, trusted data, and clear answers for the field. You will design, build, and land the targeting models, build scorecards with our cross-functional partners and Data and Analytics Leader, give Geo Ops analytics they need to run their business, and be the first stop when our field teams seek clarity on our data, reporting, and use this to improve our models. 

 What you'll do 

 

- Design, model, and land targets: Build and evolve our target setting model, and own the methodology. Back-test them, land them with GTM leaders, and keep improving them.

- Build scorecards: Work with our DIA and GTM Analytics teams to build and maintain scorecards with cross-functional partners covering field performance, data quality, and disputes.

- Support the field and apply the Rules of Engagement: Answer field questions and cases on baselines, quotas, crediting, and ownership, applying the Rules of Engagement consistently and keeping a record of each decision. Spot where a rule needs to change, and provide the account hierarchy and ownership data teams need to collaborate across geos on our most critical customers. 

- Support territory planning and partner across teams: Provide analytics to Geo Ops and central territory design so they can deliver successful territory and coverage plans with equitable distribution of opportunity and targets. Work with Finance, Billing, data engineering, IT, RevOps, and Compensation to define data needs and move manual spreadsheet work into governed data products. 

- Use AI to scale the work: Use AI tools, to write and review SQL, speed up reconciliations, draft answers to common field questions, and automate recurring checks. Review every result for accuracy and follow Cloudflare policy on confidential data. 
 
 Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience 

 

- Experience: 5 or more years in sales operations, revenue operations, business analytics, target setting or territory modelling, or data operations, ideally in a usage-based or billing-driven business 

- Modelling: You can build and back-test a quota or forecast model and explain its assumptions 

- SQL and data: Strong SQL on large datasets (BigQuery or similar), reconciling against CRM and billing data 

- Reporting: You have built scorecards or dashboards that other teams rely on 

- Controls and policy mindset: You understand why accuracy, documentation, and an audit trail matter when numbers drive pay, and you can apply a written policy such as the Rules of Engagement consistently to real cases 

- Communication: You explain technical answers clearly and calmly to sellers and managers, and work well with Geo Ops, Finance, Billing, data engineering, and IT 

- AI fluency: You already use AI assistants and agents in your daily work for analysis, coding, and documentation, check their output against the data, and can show examples of work you made faster or better with AI 
 
 Bonus points 

 

- Salesforce: Experience with reports, SQL, account hierarchies, and ownership rules 

- Building with AI: Experience building your own automations, agents, or prompts that handle routine analysis, reporting, or support questions

 Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location. 

 

- For SF, SJ, and Bay Area Metro based hires: Estimated annual salary of $138,000 - $190,000. 

- For Boston, California - Remote, Connecticut - Remote, DC Metro, Massachusetts - Remote, New Jersey - Remote, New York City, NY Metro, Remote - Washington, Washington (Kirkland), and Washington D.C. based hires: Estimated annual salary of $132,000 - $182,000. 

- For Colorado - Remote, Illinois - Remote, Maryland - Remote, Minnesota - Remote, Nevada - Remote, New York - Remote, Rhode Island - Remote, and Vermont - Remote based hires: Estimated annual base salary of $120,000 - $165,000.

description:

 At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community.  Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

 Instacart is a Flex First team 

 There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events.  Overview 

 We are hiring a Senior Salesforce Developer to join the IT Business Systems team, which owns the CRM platform that every business unit at Instacart depends on. You will design, build, and ship solutions across Sales Cloud, Salesforce CPQ, Service Cloud, and Contact Center, with an immediate focus on the CPQ Phase 2 migration, the HighRadius integration, and the migration of our contact center to Agentforce Contact Center. These are multi-million dollar initiatives touching Sales, Finance, and Customer Experience, and you will present your work to VP-level stakeholders. You will also use AI-assisted tooling such as Claude Code and Cursor to deliver faster and at higher quality, and to raise the engineering bar for the team.

 

 About the Job 

 

- Deliver the HighRadius integration and CPQ Phase 2 implementation, and get the Contact Center migration to Agentforce ready for testing and launch without P0 incidents

title: Revenue Operations Manager
description:
About the role 

 Databricks bills customers on usage. Every month, millions of usage records turn into commit drawdowns, invoices and revenue. The Revenue Operations team within Order to Cash organization makes sure that happens accurately and on time.

 We’re hiring a Revenue Operations Manager to oversee usage operations and improve how contracts move from booking to invoicing. A key focus is Universal Commitment, our cloud-agnostic commit model. Reporting to the Senior Manager of Revenue Operations, you’ll lead key month-end close activities for our billing and rating platform, oversee a team based in India, and drive process and automation improvements across Revenue Operations. 

 You'll work closely with the Order to Revenue Process Compliance team. That team sets usage policy, leads root-cause analysis and owns governance. Your team carries out the work: applying adjustments, keeping usage and billing in balance, and making sure each correction is documented, reviewed and fully reflected in our systems.

 What you'll do 

 Revenue operations and contract setup 

 

- Own the booking review process. Validate orders in the booking queue and serve as the escalation point for upstream teams on complex contract structures. 

- Make sure contract and usage settings are correct across our billing and rating platform, ERP and CPQ, so that Universal Commitment and other contract type invoice as intended. 

- Advise Deal Desk and Revenue Assurance on whether non-standard terms can be billed (e.g., GPU reservations, per-hour pricing, custom SKUs) before deals close. Provide guidance on new product offerings and ensure operational feasibility prior to finance sign off. 

- Define and report Revenue Operations KPIs, such as adjustment volume, close timeliness, and billing accuracy. 
 
 Usage operations and adjustments 

 

- Oversee and approve usage adjustments, billing corrections and customer credits in DBAR and the ERP. This covers billing errors, SLA credits and customer satisfaction (CSAT) credits, in line with Usage Compliance policies and approval levels. 

- Serve as the escalation point for manual usage processing, including manual usage uploads, reservation and non-standard billing, ledger entries, and retract-and-restate corrections, with a full audit trail. 

- Make sure usage-to-contract mapping, including customer workspace moves, PAYG-to-commit conversions and mid-term contract changes, with the correct effective dates. 

- Act as the Revenue Operations owner of the refund and credit process, from intake, and validation through execution. 

- Approve or deny account provisioning requests (suspend, unsuspend, grace-period extensions) with the Network Operations Center (NOC). 

- Oversee usage tracking for customers with special provisions and non-standard language in their order form. 
 
 Month-end and quarter-end close 

 

- Lead our contract reconciliation which ingests and compares usage across all clouds at the contractual level. Partner with Engineering, from pre-close through delivery of the final usage file to Revenue Accounting . 

- Run usage categorization and commit and PAYG reconciliations, between the billing platform and the ERP across all clouds. 

- Own billing finalization (Billing Mass Finalization / ledger freeze), the step that closes each month. 

- Partner with the Revenue Accounting on usage flux analysis and contribute to shorten the close timeline. 

- Act as preparer and /or reviewer for assigned SOX controls (e.g., usage reconciliation and SKU pricing accuracy) and keep audit evidence ready.Align with RevOps team to continue to improve recon process by assimilating processes across all clouds. Oversee Universal Commit contract reconciliation to ensure completeness. 
 
 Team leadership and scale 

 

- Lead and develop the GBS usage team (India). Set priorities, review work, and steadily expand team ownership.Write, maintain and centrally store SOPs for every recurring process, and make sure each critical close task has a trained backup. 

- Use SQL and Databricks dashboards to automate reconciliations and reduce manual effort, working toward touchless billing. 
 
 Cross-functional partnership 

 

- Partner with the Usage Compliance team. Hand off recurring adjustment patterns and supporting data for root-cause analysis, put new policies into practice, and report adjustment volume and status. 

- Work with the Money/DBAR Engineering, IT/Business Systems, Deal Desk, Billing, Collections and Revenue Accounting teams to resolve usage and billing issues quickly. 

- 

- Serve as subject matter expert on strategic initiatives and projects by working with our commercialization team, engineering, and other GTM and Accounting teams. Will require driving project initiatives in certain cases. 
 
 What we're looking for 

 Required 

 

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business or a related field. 

- 6+ years in revenue operations, billing operations or order-to-cash, ideally with usage- or consumption-based billing. 

- 2+ years managing people, including leading offshore or shared-service teams. 

- Hands-on experience with billing or rating systems and a major ERP (e.g., SAP, NetSuite or Oracle), plus Salesforce/CPQ. 

- Strong SQL skills. Experience with Databricks is a plus. 

- Track record of running month-end close tasks on time, with SOX controls. 

- Experience leading or guiding offshore or shared-services teams. 

- Clear written communication and a habit of documenting your work and sharing knowledge openly. 
 
 Nice to have 

 

- Experience with commit, drawdown and burst contract models, or cloud marketplace billing (AWS, Azure, GCP). 

- Working knowledge of usage-based revenue recognition (ASC 606). 

- Experience with system migrations or parallel runs for billing or ERP platforms.

title: Revenue Operations Manager

description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

 About Us 
Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

 

 About the Role 

 Field operations is where strategy meets execution at Fivetran + dbt Labs. This senior role sits at the heart of how our APJ go-to-market engine is planned, measured, and improved, partnering directly with regional sales leadership to shape where we play, how we allocate capacity, and how we turn pipeline into revenue. You will own the operating cadence that keeps the region on plan and the analysis that turns performance data into the decisions leadership acts on. 

 This is a role for someone who wants to shape how a high-growth business is run, not just report on it. You will operate with real autonomy: bringing rigour to how we plan, sharpening the weekly rhythm of the business, and building the processes that let APJ scale. If you think commercially, act like an owner, and want a seat close to where the decisions get made, this is for you.

 
This is a full-time position based out of either Singapore or Sydney office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

 

 Technologies You'll Use 

 Clari, Salesforce, Omni, Looker (or similar BI tools such as Tableau, Hex), SQL/SOQL, advanced spreadsheet modelling and presentation skills (Google suite), Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and other market leading ai tools 

 

 What You'll Do 

 

 Strategy and go-to-market planning 

 

- Contribute to and, over time, own core GTM planning cycles across quota setting, territory design, and financial / capacity planning, in partnership with sales leadership and finance. 

- Translate top-down targets into workable, bottoms-up plans that reps and managers trust. 
 
 

 Business reviews and insight 

 

- Prepare and drive QBRs and other business reviews, turning data into a clear narrative of what’s working, what isn’t, and what to do next. 

- Go beyond reporting: surface the “so what” and translate insight into concrete, owned actions. 
 
 

 Running the day-to-day 

 

- Lead the weekly operating rhythm: forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and inspection of deal health and hygiene. 

- Keep the leadership team on top of the number with accurate, timely, decision-ready analysis. 
 
 

 Process and systems 

 

- Improve the machine, not just run it. Build scalable, repeatable processes where none exist and remove manual, error-prone work. 

- Act as a power user of our core stack (Salesforce, Omni, Looker) and raise the bar on data quality and pipeline hygiene across the region.

- Proven experience in a sales, revenue, or field operations role in a high-growth B2B SaaS or technology business, with comfort building the first version of something where no process exists in a fast-moving environment. 

- Hands-on command of GTM planning components (quota, territory, and financial / capacity planning), even if you haven’t yet owned all three end-to-end. 

- Strong analytical toolkit: advanced spreadsheet modelling, fluency in a BI tool (Omni, Looker, Tableau or similar), and comfort working directly in a CRM (Salesforce). SQL is a strong plus. 

- A track record of turning data into insight into action: you tell the story, not just build the report 

- Genuine commercial and SaaS acumen: pipeline coverage, conversion and win rates, forecasting, ARR and retention are second nature 

- Ability to influence senior stakeholders without authority: you can move sales leaders, finance and marketing and other cross functional partners without managing any of them. 

- A clear point of view on the role AI can play in a modern GTM engine, backed by practical examples of how you have already built skills and applied it to your own work, not just theory 
 
 Bonus Skills 

 

- SQL/SOQL and experience working with a modern data stack (dbt itself a plus). 

- Experience supporting a multi-country region across markets and segments. 
 

 Perks and Benefits

- Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. 

- RSU stock grants* 

- Professional development and training opportunities 

- Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities 

- Monthly cell phone stipend
