title: Sales Operations Lead
description:
At Braze, we have found our people. We’re a genuinely approachable, exceptionally kind, and intensely passionate crew.

 We seek to ignite that passion by setting high standards, championing teamwork, and creating work-life harmony as we collectively navigate rapid growth on a global scale while striving for greater equity and opportunity – inside and outside our organization.

 To flourish here, you must be prepared to set a high bar for yourself and those around you. There is always a way to contribute: Acting with autonomy, having accountability and being open to new perspectives are essential to our continued success.

 Our deep curiosity to learn and our eagerness to share diverse passions with others gives us balance and injects a one-of-a-kind vibrancy into our culture.

 If you are driven to solve exhilarating challenges and have a bias toward action in the face of change, you will be empowered to make a real impact here, with a sharp and passionate team at your back. If Braze sounds like a place where you can thrive, we can’t wait to meet you.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO 

 As a Sales Operations Lead, you will be the operational and analytical partner to our Global Account Management and AI Sales leadership team, owning the planning, process, and data foundations that drive expansion at scale. This role blends hands-on execution with a strategic lens: you’ll keep today’s data and processes running, while shaping how we scale them and build the team to support continued growth. 

 Territory, Quota & Capacity Planning 

 

- Own the annual territory and account-assignment process for Global AM and AI Sales, ensuring accuracy and equitability, and recommend structures that drive focus while giving reps a realistic path to attainment 

- Collaborate with regional Sales Ops leaders to align on coverage and rules of engagement between Account Management, AI Sales, and Account Executives, including account assignment, crediting, and handoffs 

- Build capacity models that translate growth targets into global headcount, coverage, and quota scenarios, and partner with Finance and Sales Leadership on quota and comp plan inputs 
 
 Scaling Our Processes 

 

- Run the operating cadence and turn tribal-knowledge processes into ones that are documented and repeatable 

- Lead cross-functional initiatives from scoping to adoption to evolve our sales processes, identifying bottlenecks before they slow down the business 
 
 Data & Reporting Infrastructure 

 

- Define the metrics framework and reporting for Global AM and AI Sales that give leadership real time visibility into performance 

- Analyze sales data, KPIs, and trends to surface insights and provide recommendations to leaders on where to focus 

- Partner with Sales Leadership on forecasting cadences and own forecast data quality and accuracy 
 
 AI-Driven Process Improvement 

 

- Collaborate with Sales Ops leaders to drive the AI strategy for Sales Ops, identifying and prioritizing opportunities to use AI to automate manual workflows 

- Design AI-driven workflows to improve efficiency across the Global AM and AI Sales team, partnering with our in-house AI architect team to bring them to life and measure impact 
 
 WHO YOU ARE 

 

- Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business-oriented field, or equivalent practical experience 

- 6+ years of experience in Go-to-Market Operations, Sales Strategy and Operations, or Revenue Operations at a high growth B2B SaaS company 

- Experience with overlay or specialist sales models and supporting a global team across regions a plus 

- Technically savvy, with a solid understanding of Salesforce flows and automations; you’ll translate business needs into requirements and own prioritization with Business Systems 

- Hands-on experience with Sales tech stack tools such as Clay, ZoomInfo, Clari, Gong, Outreach, or Fullcast 

- Proficient with Google Sheets and BI tools such as Tableau or Looker, with experience building dashboards from scratch 

- Comfortable using AI tools to speed up analysis, data cleaning, and reporting, and curious about where AI can remove manual work from Sales Ops processes 

- Strong analytical and problem solving skills, with the attention to detail to get into the data and make data driven decisions. 

- Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to present key insights and the “so what” to senior sales leaders, to build trust quickly, and to push back with data when needed 

- Has built structure and process where none existed, and takes ownership of strategy and outcomes, not just tasks 

 For candidates based in the United States, the pay range for this position at the start of employment is expected to be between $94,000 and $135,900/year, with an expected On Target Earnings (OTE) between $106,000 and $151,000/year (including bonus or commission).Your exact offer may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to cash compensation, this role qualifies for a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes equity grants of restricted stock (RSUs) so that you will own a piece of our company. 

 
 
 #LI-Hybrid 

 WHAT WE OFFER 

 Braze benefits vary by location, and we encourage you to review our specific benefits offerings for each country at here . More details on benefits plans will be provided if you receive an offer of employment. 

 From offering comprehensive benefits to fostering hybrid ways of working, we've got you covered so you can prioritize work-life harmony. Braze offers benefits such as:

 

- Competitive compensation that may include equity 

- Retirement and Employee Stock Purchase Plans 

- Flexible paid time off 

- Comprehensive benefit plans covering medical, dental, vision, life, and disability 

- Family services that include fertility benefits and equal paid parental leave 

- Professional development supported by formal career pathing, learning platforms, and a yearly learning stipend 

- A curated in-office employee experience, designed to foster community, team connections, and innovation 

- Opportunities to give back to your community, including an annual company-wide Volunteer Week and donation matching 

- Employee Resource Groups that provide supportive communities within Braze 

- Collaborative, transparent, and fun culture recognized as a Great Place to Work® 
 
 ABOUT BRAZE 

 Braze is the leading customer engagement platform that empowers brands to Be Absolutely Engaging™ Braze helps brands deliver great customer experiences that drive value both for consumers and for their businesses. Built on a foundation of composable intelligence, BrazeAI™ allows marketers to combine and activate AI agents, models, and features at every touchpoint throughout the Braze Customer Engagement Platform for smarter, faster, and more meaningful customer engagement. From cross-channel messaging and journey orchestration to Al-powered decisioning and optimization, Braze enables companies to turn action into interaction through autonomous, 1:1 personalized experiences.

 The company has repeatedly been recognized as a Leader in marketing technology by industry analysts, and was voted a G2 “Best of Marketing and Digital Advertising Software Product” in 2025.

 Braze was also named a 2025 Best Companies To Work For by U.S. News and World Report, a 2025 America’s Greatest Companies by Newsweek, and a 2025 Fortune Best Workplace in Technology™ by Great Place To Work®, among other accolades. Braze is also proudly certified as a Great Place to Work® in the U.S., the UK, Australia, and Singapore.

 The company is headquartered in New York with offices in Austin, Berlin, Bucharest, Chicago, Dubai, Jakarta, London, Paris, San Francisco, São Paulo, Singapore, Seoul, Sydney and Tokyo.

 BRAZE IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER 

 At Braze, we strive to create equitable growth and opportunities inside and outside the organization.

 Building meaningful connections is at the heart of everything we do, and that includes our recruiting practices. We're committed to offering all candidates a fair, accessible, and inclusive experience – regardless of age, color, disability, gender identity, marital status, maternity, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran. When applying and interviewing with Braze, we want you to feel comfortable showcasing what makes you you.

 We know that sometimes different circumstances can lead talented people to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet 100% of the criteria. If this sounds familiar, we encourage you to apply, as we’d love to meet you

 OUR AI-POWERED BRAZE RECRUITMENT PROCESS 

 At Braze, we’re committed to a fair and transparent candidate experience. To help our recruitment teams focus on what matters most — the person behind each application — we use AI-assisted tools at certain stages of our recruitment process.

 This includes using AI to analyze the experience, skills and qualifications in your application materials to help with screening and prioritizing candidates. Such screening may amount to a form of solely automated decision-making. We also use AI for administrative support, like scheduling and recording interviews and summarizing interview notes. Our recruiting teams remain responsible for all hiring decisions and are involved throughout the process.

 Depending on where you are located, you may have certain rights available to you in relation to Braze’s use of AI:

 

- To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” at the end of the application form below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application. 

- To exercise other types of rights, such as rights to request further information about how AI is used in our recruitment process, to request a retroactive manual review of any decision made or to contest a decision, please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com . 
 
 Please contact us at talentdata.privacy@braze.com with any questions. To find out more about our hiring process, check out this page .

 Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tool (NYC Local Law 144) 

 Our use of AI during the application review process may include the use of automated employment decision tools. Pursuant to New York City Local Law 144, for roles based in New York City, or if you reside in New York City, you have the right to request an alternative selection process or a reasonable accommodation instead of AI-assisted review. 

 To opt out of AI-assisted review of your application, please click the “Learn More” button below and follow the instructions before submitting your application. Please note, if you apply to multiple roles at Braze, you will need to opt out in relation to each application. Please submit any other request to our Talent Acquisition team at talentdata.privacy@braze.com promptly after applying. Summaries of the most recent bias audit results for such tools are available here .

 Please see our Candidate Privacy Policy for more information on how Braze processes your personal information during the recruitment process and, if applicable based on your location, how you can exercise any privacy rights.

title: Principal GTM Operations Analyst
description:
GTM Operations & Strategy at MongoDB is a global team of builders and innovators focused on unleashing MongoDB’s sales greatness by pairing world‑class analytics with scalable operations. Within GTM Operations, the GTM Intelligence - Applied Science team turns complex GTM data into tools, models, and insights that help our sales organization make better, faster decisions across our people, segmentation, territory design, forecasting, and account prioritization.

 As a Principal Analyst on the Applied Science team, you will set the technical direction for our GTM model portfolio and personally lead our highest‑stakes programs, from framing problems with SVP‑level stakeholders, through data engineering and model design, to productionalized workflows, dashboards, and executive‑ready narratives that change how the field operates. This role will be based remotely in the United States, and supports a global stakeholder set across regions and GTM functions.

 What You’ll Do

 Own the model portfolio and roadmap for one or more domains

 

- Set the multi‑quarter roadmap for a given GTM model portfolio domain, deciding what to build, retire, or invest in based on measured business impact 

- Act as the senior analytical thought partner to GTM leadership, shaping which questions the team takes on, not just how it answers them 
 
 Translate GTM questions into analytical projects

 

- Partner with GTM Ops, Sales Strategy & Planning, Sales Leadership, and Central Analytics to scope problems, define success criteria, and prioritize work across areas like segmentation, territory design, account prioritization, and pipeline/forecast health 

- Structure ambiguous questions into hypotheses, analytical plans, and clear recommendations for senior stakeholders (SVPs, RVPs, functional leaders) 
 
 Design and build scalable analytics & models

 

- Develop and maintain statistical and machine learning models (e.g., NARR prediction, deal qualification, account momentum, workload identification) that inform forecast expectations, territory assignments, and deal prioritization 

- Engineer robust data pipelines and features (SQL/Python) on top of our GTM data stack (Salesforce, product usage, call transcripts, marketing signals, etc.) in partnership with data and platform teams 
 
 Own core GTM analytics assets

 

- Lead flagship programs such as Forecasting 3.0 / Atlas Forecasting Calculator, Customer 360 Revamp, GTM Metrics 3.0, and territory optimization initiatives, ensuring they are statistically sound, explainable, and operationally durable 

- Build and govern self‑serve analytics assets (e.g., Sigma workbooks, curated datasets) that allow GTM stakeholders to answer their own questions safely and consistently 
 
 Measure and prove impact

 

- Design experiments, holdouts, and causal analyses that quantify the revenue and efficiency impact of our models and GTM investments, and make that evidence the basis for investment decisions 
 
 Turn analysis into decisions and change

 

- Deliver concise, executive‑ready narratives (memos, scorecards, and QBR/MBR content) that highlight trade‑offs and explicit recommendations, not just data and charts 

- Run stakeholder working sessions to align on scenarios, validate model outcomes, and embed recommendations into operating rhythms (e.g., segmentation reviews, annual planning, forecast calls) 
 
 Advance our GTM data & AI foundations

 

- Define how we use new GTM data sources such as call transcript modeling, workload inference, and account intelligence to unlock novel scoring and routing use cases 

- Set the standards for testing, monitoring, documentation, and change management of GTM models and analytics products, in partnership with Central Analytics and GTM Tech 
 
 Multiply the team

 

- Mentor analysts and data scientists, review their technical work, and raise the bar for rigor across our teams 

- Create clear documentation, playbooks, and training to help other analysts and GTM stakeholders understand and safely use the models, tools, and datasets you own 

- Contribute to a strong culture of technical rigor, peer review, and knowledge sharing within Sales Intelligence and the broader GTM Operations community 
 
 What We’re Looking For

 Experience

 

- ~8-12+ years in analytics, sales operations, data science, or strategy/consulting roles supporting B2B or SaaS go‑to‑market teams (or equivalent high‑impact analytical experience) 

- Demonstrated track record owning complex analytics projects end‑to‑end (from scoping through production deployment and stakeholder adoption), ideally in forecasting, segmentation/territory design, or account/deal scoring domains 

- Track record of leading multi‑quarter, cross‑functional analytics programs and influencing executive decisions without direct authority 

- Experience setting technical direction or standards for a team or a portfolio of production models 

- Experience working directly with senior commercial stakeholders (e.g., Sales/GTM leaders) and turning analysis into concrete decisions and measurable business impact 
 
 Technical Skills

 

- Advanced SQL and strong Python (or equivalent) for data wrangling, feature engineering, and statistical / ML modeling 

- Comfort working with large, messy datasets spanning CRM (Salesforce), product usage, and marketing/sales engagement tools 

- Experience with at least one modern BI / analytics environment (e.g., Sigma, Looker, Tableau) and building self‑serve, governed assets for business users 

- Solid grounding in statistical thinking (sampling, backtesting, lift/impact measurement) and model validation practices 

- Experimentation and causal inference (e.g., A/B and holdout design, difference‑in‑differences, regression discontinuity) 

- Experience with forecasting and time‑series models 
 
 Problem‑Solving & Communication

 

- Ability to decompose ambiguous business questions into structured analytical plans, with clear assumptions, risks, and trade‑offs 

- Strong written and verbal communication: you can explain complex models and data decisions in simple, GTM‑friendly language and build trust with non‑technical stakeholders 

- Bias toward action and ownership: you are comfortable making recommendations under uncertainty and iterating as new data arrives 
 
 Nice to Have

 

- Prior experience in Sales Operations / Revenue Operations or GTM Strategy at a high‑growth SaaS company 

- Experience with commercial applications of NLP / LLMs (e.g., call transcript analytics, opportunity notes analysis) 

- Familiarity with MongoDB’s ecosystem (Atlas, GTM motions, sales process) or similar modern cloud data platforms 

- Experience contributing to cross‑functional programs such as Customer 360, self‑serve analytics initiatives, or GTM data/metrics standardization 
 
 About MongoDB

 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world!

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

 MongoDB, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and makes all hiring decisions without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Compensation at the time of offer is unique to each candidate and based on a variety of factors such as skill set, experience, qualifications, and work location. Salary is one part of MongoDB’s total compensation and benefits package. Other benefits for eligible employees may include: equity, participation in the employee stock purchase program, flexible paid time off, 20 weeks fully-paid gender-neutral parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, 401(k) plan, mental health counseling, access to transgender-inclusive health insurance coverage, and health benefits offerings.  GTM Engineer III (Professional Services)

As a GTM Engineer III you will conduct discovery, design and build solutions, validate results, mentor newer team members, and begin contributing to pre-sales scoping and proposal development.

 This is a full-time role that can be held from our New York hub or remotely within the Eastern US time zone. 

 What you’ll do at Figma:

 

- Serve as a trusted thought partner and strategic advisor to the SVP of AMER Sales — translating business performance, market trends, and field insights into clear recommendations that shape regional priorities, guide investment decisions, and accelerate growth 

- Assist the forecasting process for Mid-Market, Enterprise & Strategic, bringing rigor and repeatability to pipeline reviews

title: Senior Revenue Operations Specialist - Salesforce & GTM Automation
description:
About DataCamp 

 DataCamp's mission is to empower everyone with the data and AI skills essential for 21st-century success. By providing practical, engaging learning experiences, DataCamp equips learners and organizations of all sizes to harness the power of data and AI. As a trusted partner to over 20 million learners and 6,000+ companies , including 80% of the Fortune 1000, DataCamp is leading the charge in addressing the critical data and AI skills shortage.

 About the role 

 We are looking for an experienced candidate to join our growing Revenue Operations (RevOps) team. This is a high-ownership position that will report directly to the Director of Revenue Operations. In this position you will work with members of Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal and Leadership teams. This role owns the most technically demanding quote-to-contracting workstreams as well as the optimal set up of our key GTM software in the RevOps function, which is responsible for optimizing sales processes, implementing sales technologies, and ensuring the sales team operates efficiently to support business growth and customer satisfaction. 

 The right hire is an experienced revenue operations administrator who has since built industry experience at a US SaaS or technology growth-stage startup company and has implemented AI-enabled processes and workflows — someone who combines deep technical rigor with a hands-on operating style, and who is genuinely excited about using AI tools to reimagine what a lean, high-performing RevOps team can do.

 In summary, the role is a Senior Sales Ops specialist as well as a GTM Engineer.

 About you 

 At DataCamp, we seek individuals who embody our core values of data-driven decision-making, action, transparency, ownership, and customer focus. You thrive in a fast-paced, high-performing environment and are driven by a passion for making a meaningful impact. You're adaptable, embracing change and ambiguity with enthusiasm. Your initiative and entrepreneurial spirit push you beyond just meeting targets—you aim to understand the "why" behind our goals and take ownership to drive the business forward. You’re a collaborative team player who values transparency and always seeks to improve and innovate. If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply!

 Responsibilities 

 

- Manage the day-to-day quote and pricing approvals 

- Own post-signature deal hygiene: reconcile Salesforce and LinkSquares contract management data, update opportunity stage to Closed-Won, and route approved quotes to Zuora for billing setup 

- Identify and implement process improvements and automations, also using AI, to maintain sales data quality and integrity across Salesforce and adjacent commercial systems 

- Maintain recurring sales reporting and dashboards (e.g., pipeline and leadership spot reports) and field ad hoc reporting requests from AEs and sales managers with AI tools 

- Partner with our commercial teams to ensure opportunities are properly created and tracked in Salesforce, including stage, probability, booking amount, and other key fields 

- Create standard templates, playbooks, and sales guidance documents that streamline the quote-to-contracting process 

- Serve as the first line of defense for tackling small cleanliness/technical issues on everything deal flow related 

- Manage lead and account enrichment tooling (e.g., ZoomInfo, Lusha, Clay) and keep enrichment workflows current with vendor changes 

- Maintain LinkSquares order form templates in coordination with Legal and Finance 

- Actively leverage AI tools, including Claude Code, Claude Cowork or similar, to identify and implement automation opportunities across the RevOps function; serve as a hands-on practitioner, not just a sponsor. 
 
 Qualifications 

 

- Certified Salesforce Administrator credential 

- Strong experience working with Salesforce. 

- Strong quantitative/data skills. Experience building BI reports using SQL. 

- AI fluency - Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI tools (e.g. Claude) to automate RevOps workflows. 

- Strong excel and spreadsheet skills. 

- Strong English language skills. 

- Operating Style - Operates independently; owns outcomes rather than tasks. Comfortable in a lean, fast-moving team where the answer isn’t always obvious. 

- Strong attention to detail, organization skills and excellent problem-solving skills. 
 
 Nice to Have 

 

- Certified Salesforce Developer credential 

- Experience with Lemlist and/or LinkedIn Sales Navigator 

- Experience working with Zuora Billing CPQX integration with Salesforce 

- US-based multi-national SaaS/technology growth-stage startup experience 
 
 Why Datacamp? 

 Joining DataCamp means becoming part of a dynamic, creative, and international start-up. Here are just a few of the reasons why you’ll love being on our team:

 

- Exciting challenges: Face new technical challenges daily, keeping your work engaging and rewarding. 

- Competitive compensation: We offer a competitive salary with attractive benefits. 

- Flexibility: Benefit from flexible working hours because the future is flexible! 

- Continuous learning: Access a yearly learning budget for conferences & training to support your professional growth. 

- Global retreats: Participate in international company retreats, fostering a global team spirit. 

- Equipment: Yearly refreshment of your IT Equipment budget for your home working setup. 

- Amazing team: Collaborate with a truly exceptional team—seriously, we’re awesome!

title: Revenue Operations Manager - EMEA
description:
About the Job:

 We're looking for a Revenue Operations Manager, EMEA to be the go-to operator for our EMEA GTM team. This is a high-impact, highly visible role for someone who wants to shape how a growing region runs, from the first marketing touch to the closed deal and beyond.
You'll join our GTM Operations team as the face of operations in EMEA, partnering day-to day with Marketing, SDR, Sales, Solution Engineering, and Customer Success leaders across the lifecycle. You'll turn strategy into the processes, cadences, and insights that move the number. And you won't build alone: a global RevOps team stands behind you with builders and enablement teams to give you the foundation to develop what you design, and enablement to help teach your stakeholders how to be successful.
As we build in-region Field Operations coverage, you'll set the playbook for how LaunchDarkly runs in EMEA, and you'll see your impact within your first 90 days, not your first year. If you're a business partner at heart who loves turning ambiguity into rhythm and results, this role is for you.

 Why This Role Matters: 

 

- High Impact: You'll own the rituals that make EMEA pipeline and forecasting trustworthy, with a direct line to revenue in one of our key regions. Support EMEA in bringing forecast accuracy within +/- 5% accurate. 

- Strategic Influence: Be the voice of EMEA inside GTM Operations and a trusted partner to regional GTM leadership 

- Break New Ground: Help build in-region operations coverage and set the operating playbook for the region 

- Career Growth: Gain exposure across the full GTM lifecycle, from Marketing and Sales to Customer Success, at a high-growth B2B company 

- Regional Playbooks: Adapt global plays for land, expand, and renewals. Track how playbooks drive conversion and optimize over time. 
 
 Responsibilities:

 

- Business Partnership : Serve as the named operations partner for EMEA's Marketing, Sales & Customer Success leaders. Join their operating meetings, know their number, pipeline, and top risks, and bring insight before you're asked. 

- First Line of Defense : Own intake for EMEA field requests. Answer, route to the right operations team, or escalate, so the field never needs to navigate our org chart. 

- Operating Cadence : Run the EMEA forecast, pipeline, and business review cadence. Inspect pipe hygiene with leaders so each forecast is based on clean data, and each meeting ends in strong data-driven decisions, not updates. 

- Strategy -> Process: Apply our global processes, handoffs, and rules of engagement in EMEA. Own the regional variants and keep them documented. 

- Actionable Insights : Use standard data to find what drives the pipeline, understand what becomes a win, help leaders understand their teams. Recommend the change and see it through. 

- Planning Inputs : Bring what the field knows (territory health, ramp, pipe coverage, and in-market demand generation) to Planning and FP&A so EMEA plans reflect realistic expectations. 

- Adoption & Accountability : Partner with Enablement on new motions and launches, then inspect adoption through the cadence and close the gaps. 

- Voice of the Field : Bring EMEA priorities into operational planning and partner with Systems teams to define clear business requirements. 
 
 About You:

 

- You are a business partner first who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and operations. 

- You're fluent in the language of pipeline and forecasting, but just as comfortable sitting with a rep as with a VP. 

- You take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks, and you hold yourself to a high bar. 

- You move fast with an 80/20 mindset, and you can look at a process you built and say "this isn't working" without defensiveness. 

- You know how to influence without authority, and you build relationships before you push for change. 

- You stay curious, embrace feedback, and keep looking for ways to level up yourself and those around you. 

- You’re energized by working across multiple EMEA markets, and you keep a global team aligned from a different time zone. 
 
 Qualifications:

 

- Typically requires 8 years of experience, or equivalent depth of expertise, in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Marketing Operations, or a related GTM operations role 

- Experience supporting EMEA GTM teams, ideally in a regional-focused capacity 

- Proven experience running forecast, pipeline, and business review cadences with senior GTM leaders 

- Strong working knowledge of the full GTM lifecycle, including lead management, pipeline generation, sales stages, and customer handoffs 

- Hands-on Salesforce experience, with the ability to write clear business requirements for systems product owners and developers 

- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable recommendations 

- Experience at a B2B SaaS or high-growth tech company 

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without authority 

- Experience with GTM tools like Salesforce, Gong, Looker, Outreach, Cognism 
 
 About LaunchDarkly: 

 Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong.  The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

- Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize 

- Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types 

- Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

title: Director, Sales Strategy & Operations
description:
PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE: PD) is the global leader in AI-first digital operations. By automatically detecting, diagnosing, and remediating issues, the PagerDuty Platform orchestrates AI agents and automated workflows with context from over 750 integrations. Trusted by approximately two-thirds of the Fortune 100 and nearly half of the Fortune 500, PagerDuty is the industry standard for organizations scaling resilient, autonomous operations. Notable customers include Chipotle, Cloudflare, Docusign, Fox, Nvidia, Salesforce, Spotify, Zoom and more. We are growing rapidly and hiring top talent with leading AI skills across engineering, sales, product, marketing, and beyond as we build the leading digital operations platform.

 

 PagerDuty is seeking a Director, Sales & Customer Success Operations – Americas to serve as a senior operator and trusted advisor to our Americas Sales and Customer Success leadership. Reporting to the VP, Field Operations, you will lead sales planning and translate company strategy into a scalable, repeatable Americas go-to-market engine spanning the full customer lifecycle across Commercial, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments. This role looks beyond the current quarter: you will anticipate what the business needs next quarter, next fiscal year, and beyond, while running the operating cadence and forecast rigor that keep the region on track today.

 You will lead a team of sales and customer success operations professionals and a portfolio of strategic go-to-market initiatives. You will not own the sales or customer success technology stack; instead, you will partner closely with IT, Applications, and other stakeholders to evolve the processes and systems that support the Americas Sales and Customer Success organizations.

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES : 

 Sales Operations
 

 

- Partner with Sales leadership to execute on key imperatives 

- Drive seller productivity and remove friction from the sales motion 

- Run the operating cadence: forecast calls, pipeline inspection, deal reviews, QBRs, exec readouts 

- Improve forecast accuracy and pipeline health 

- Support the design of overage models, territories, segmentation, quotas, and capacity planning 

- Support Sales compensation, headcount, and incentive design with Finance and People 

- 

- Serve as the primary strategic and operating partner to Americas Sales leadership, translating company and regional priorities into clear plans and driving execution on key business imperatives. 

- Own the Americas sales operating cadence, including weekly forecast calls, pipeline inspection, deal reviews, QBRs, and executive performance readouts, with clear insights, actions, and accountability. 

- Drive seller and front-line manager productivity by identifying friction in the sales motion, simplifying processes, and scaling best practices across segments. 

- Improve forecast accuracy and pipeline health through consistent inspection standards, stage definitions, and leading-indicator reporting. 

- Look ahead across quarters to anticipate business performance, pipeline coverage, and resource needs, and recommend actions before gaps emerge. 
 
 Customer Success Operations 

 

- Serve as the operating partner to Americas Customer Success leadership on retention, adoption, and expansion priorities. 

- Own Customer Success operating metrics and reporting (gross and net revenue retention, churn, renewal rates, expansion, adoption, and customer health) and drive the actions that improve them. 

- Design and operationalize customer lifecycle processes, including Sales-to-CS handoffs, onboarding, health scoring, success planning, renewal management, and escalation/risk playbooks. 

- Own renewal and retention forecasting and CSM book-of-business design, including customer-to-CSM coverage ratios. 

- Own CS metrics: GRR/NRR, churn, renewals, expansion, adoption, and health 

- Lifecycle processes: Sales-to-CS handoff, onboarding, health scoring, success plans, renewals, risk playbooks 

- CSM book-of-business design and coverage ratios 

- Improve renewal and retention forecasting 

- Support CS compensation, headcount, and incentive design with Finance and People 
 
 Insights, Systems & Leadership 

 

- Translate complex plans into compelling narratives for the VP, Field Operations, Americas Sales and CS leadership, and the Executive Leadership Team. 

- Identify bottlenecks and streamline processes to improve decision speed, seller productivity, and CSM efficiency, including where AI and automation can help. 

- Partner with IT, Applications, and other stakeholders to evolve the processes and tools supporting Americas Sales and CS, defining requirements and priorities without owning the systems roadmap. 

- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of sales and customer success operations and strategy professionals. 
 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 

- The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in GTM strategy and operations, ideally in the cloud computing space 

- They will have a passion for problem-solving and an ability to think strategically and execute methodically, while identifying the root cause for the identified problems 

- They should have an aptitude for analytics and data-driven decision-making, and a proven track record of driving successful GTM strategies that include both Product Led Growth and Enterprise Selling motions 

- Demonstrated willingness to perform basic tasks such as creating analytics and writing communications, while also conducting sophisticated work for Senior Executives 

- Curiosity about business and customers (why do customers do what they do); customer-focused in running Strategy & Operations 

- Understanding of various sales tools, how to leverage them effectively, and consult GTM stakeholders on how to properly leverage them to maximize efficiency and selling motions 
 
 

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS 

 

- 
 10+ years in management consulting, sales, customer success, or business operations, GTM strategy, or business planning in enterprise software or large-scale tech

 

- SaaS/Consumption experience with deep understanding of ARR and consumption models and their metrics (bookings, pipeline coverage, GRR/NRR, churn, expansion) 

- 3+ years of direct people management leading sales ops, CS ops, strategy, or analytics teams 

- Track record leading sales planning and running the sales operating cadence with senior Sales leaders 

- Track record driving new-business and renewal forecasting, pipeline analytics, and performance governance with senior Sales and CS leaders 

- Coverage models, territory and book-of-business governance, quota setting, and capacity planning for a multi-segment Sales and CS org 

- Customer lifecycle programs: health scoring, onboarding, renewal management, churn mitigation 

- Strong command of metrics and business modeling 

- Executive-level communication with VP- and C-level audiences 

- Hands-on operator balancing strategy and execution 

- Translating business needs into requirements for IT and Applications 

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related quantitative field 
 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS 

 

- MBA or equivalent advanced degree 

- Management consulting or corporate strategy experience in GTM, sales effectiveness, or customer retention 

- Business Manager, Chief of Staff, or operating leader supporting Sales or CS executives 

- Managing a portfolio of 6–12 month initiatives in a matrixed org 

- Building scaled or digital CS motions for long-tail segments 

- Using AI tools to improve analysis, forecasting, or workflows 

- Salesforce, Tableau, Anaplan, Gong, Snowflake

 PagerDuty, Inc. (NYSE:PD) is a global leader in digital operations management. title: Revenue Operations Manager - UK
description:
EMEA Revenue Operations Manager 

 London, UK 

 Sigma is expanding its footprint across EMEA, and we need a Revenue Operations Manager to turn that plan into a working operation. You will sit at the centre of the expansion, working with sales leaders across the region to build the systems, cadences and plans that let new markets scale quickly.

 This role is less ops coordinator and more trusted advisor, with a bias for action and a sharp analytical mind. You have done market expansion work before, you would rather design the system than run the report, and you get uncomfortable when you are the last to see a problem coming.

 What you will own

 

- The operational plan for our EMEA expansion: market entry sequencing, territory and coverage design, headcount and capacity planning, and the milestones that tell us whether each new market is on track. 

- The operating rhythm of a high-growth, multi-country sales organisation, including QBRs, planning cycles, leadership offsites and the cadences that keep teams in different markets and time zones aligned. 

- Annual and half-year planning for EMEA, built from the ground up with regional sales leadership. You will own the process, the timeline and the room. 

- The health of the whole GTM engine in EMEA, from lead to upsell: lead flow, pipeline generation and coverage, conversion, forecast accuracy, renewals and expansion. 

- Strategic diagnostics: the leading indicators, structural risks and pipeline dynamics that show where each market is headed before the quarter does. 

- Regional execution detail, including multi-currency forecasting and pricing, partner and cloud marketplace deal flow, and country-specific requirements for data, contracts and hiring, in step with Finance, Legal and People. 

- AI-native workflows that remove manual work and let sales leaders spend their time on decisions, not dashboards. 

- A direct line to senior leadership, with the credibility to challenge as well as advise. You will be expected to have a view, and to defend it. 
 
 What we are looking for

 

- 8 - 10 years of experience in Sales Strategy, Revenue Operations or a Chief of Staff function inside a high-growth B2B SaaS business. 

- Direct experience of launching or scaling a sales organisation in new international markets, ideally across several EMEA countries, and a clear view of what worked and what did not. 

- Deep knowledge of how a high-performance GTM engine runs end to end, from lead to upsell: lead flow and conversion, pipeline creation and hygiene, forecasting, territory management, coverage models, renewals and expansion, operating rhythms and annual planning. 

- Strong written and verbal communication. You can take a complex situation, translate it for the right audience and land a clear point of view in two minutes or two slides. 

- Comfort with ambiguity and speed, and the flexibility to handle shifting priorities across time zones and cultures. 

- Curiosity about AI and automation, and the ability to build them into our current systems to raise speed and efficiency while keeping operational rigour. We are rebuilding how this function works at scale, and this role will be a key part of that work. 
 
 Who you are

 

- Present. You will work with experienced sales leaders and cross-functional partners who have seen every ops hire before. You build trust quickly and know how to earn a seat at the table. 

- Proactive. You look around corners, flag risks early and arrive with a point of view rather than waiting to be asked. 

- Precise. You give a sharp read and a recommended next step. No unnecessary slides and no endless dashboards. 

- A builder. You treat process as infrastructure and enjoy making things work better at scale. 
 
 Nice to have

 Fluency in one or more European languages, and experience with partner or channel operations.

 Why this role

 This role sits where that growth needs sharper operational thinking. You will not maintain a legacy system. You will help build the operation that takes Sigma into new European markets, working with sales leaders who want a real partner and a VP of Ops who cares about how this function runs. If that sounds like the work you do best, we would like to hear from you.

 About us: 

 Sigma is the AI Apps and agentic analytics platform built on the cloud data warehouse. Business and technical teams use Sigma to explore live data, build intelligent applications, and automate critical workflows all without moving data or breaking governance. Sigma supports a spreadsheet interface, SQL, Python, and native AI in a single governed workspace, giving every team the speed to act and IT the control to scale. Sigma is trusted by more than 2,000 customers, including AMD, Duolingo, Colgate-Palmolive, and JPMorgan Chase. 

 Sigma announced its $80M in Series E financing in May 2026. The round was led by Princeville Capital, with new strategic investors Databricks Ventures, ServiceNow Ventures, and Workday Ventures participating alongside returning investors Altimeter Capital, Avenir Growth Capital, D1 Capital Partners, K5 Global, NewView Capital, Spark Capital, Sutter Hill Ventures, and XN. This milestone follows Sigma reaching $200M in annual recurring revenue in April 2026, with more than 100% year-over-year growth and 1.1 million new active users added in the latest fiscal year.

 Come join us!

 Benefits For Our Full-Time Employees:

 

- Equity 

- Generous health benefits 

- Flexible time off policy. Take the time off you need! 

- Paid bonding time for all new parents 

- Traditional and Roth 401k 

- Commuter and FSA benefits 

- Lunch Program 

- Dog friendly office

title: Senior Director, GTM Data Engineering
description:
Five9 is a leader in AI-powered cloud contact center software, serving thousands of customers around the world and powering billions of customer interactions every year. We help enterprises deliver smarter customer experience with every interaction, turning every customer conversation into an opportunity to build trust, deepen loyalty, and drive growth. Our Genius CX platform combines deep contact center expertise with applied AI to deliver outcomes the business can measure.

 Our team-first culture enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together.

 

 We are looking for a Senior Director of Data Engineering to build and run the data foundation that the rest of Five9’s GTM Data and Analytics team works through. Reporting to the Vice President, GTM Data and Analytics, this leader will own the pipelines, integrations, and data models that bring third-party data, internal systems, and product data together into one foundation of truth for Marketing, Sales, Partner, and Product.

 This is a senior leadership role with broad technical scope. The Senior Director, Data Engineering will build data sets that are robust enough to trust and flexible enough to answer questions no one has asked yet — absorbing complexity rather than passing it along to the people who use them. They will also build the resources that let technical and non-technical users get answers to their own data questions through AI, and they will make sure every layer of the foundation is wrapped in SOX-compliant security.

 The right candidate is not a pipeline operator who measures success by the jobs that ran overnight, and not an architect who designs in isolation from the business. They are an engineering leader who builds for the people downstream — someone who has partnered extensively with analytics, enablement, and business teams and knows that a data set is only finished when someone can use it to make a decision. They will partner closely with the Senior Director, Data Enablement and the Senior Director, GTM Analytics & Insights, along with Data Platforms, IT, Information Security, and Finance.

 The role is hands-on at the technical level: SQL, Python, and Terraform are core to how this team builds and manages the foundation.

 Key Responsibilities

 Data Foundation & Modeling

 

- Build the unified GTM data foundation — integrated, well-modeled data sets that stitch many sources together into a single source of truth for every GTM domain. 

- Design data models that are robust and adaptable — stable enough for executive reporting, flexible enough to support new questions without a rebuild. 

- Remove complexity before it reaches the user — consistent keys, clear lineage, documented business logic, and naming that makes sense to the people who query it. 

- Set data quality standards and monitoring across the foundation — testing, freshness checks, and anomaly detection so problems are caught before the business sees them. 
 
 Third-Party Data & Integrations

 

- Own third-party data sets and the integrations that deliver them — purchased data such as intent, firmographic, contact, and technographic sources, along with the GTM applications that feed the foundation. 

- Manage the full lifecycle of external data vendors — evaluation, onboarding, contract-aligned usage, quality monitoring, and retirement, in partnership with Procurement and the business. 

- Build resilient, well-monitored integration pipelines — so upstream changes are detected and handled without breaking downstream reporting. 

- Resolve entities across external and internal sources — accounts, contacts, and partners reconciled into one consistent view. 
 
 Internal & Product Data

 

- Own internal and product data sets for GTM use — CRM, marketing, customer success, partner, financial, and product usage data integrated into the foundation. 

- Partner with Product and Engineering on product telemetry — defining what is captured, how it lands, and how it connects to customer and account records. 

- Make product usage data usable for GTM decisions — modeled into adoption, health, and expansion signals that Analytics & Insights can build on. 
 
 AI Enablement & Self-Service

 

- Build resources that let users answer data questions through AI — governed data sets, metadata, and interfaces designed so technical and non-technical users get accurate answers in plain language. 

- Structure data and documentation so AI tools return trustworthy results — clear definitions, rich metadata, and business context that reduce the chance of a confident wrong answer. 

- Partner with Data Enablement on adoption of AI resources — so what engineering builds is discoverable, supported, and used across the business. 

- Measure whether AI-driven self-service is working — answer accuracy, usage, and the volume of questions that no longer need an analyst. 
 
 SOX-Compliant Security & Controls

 

- Wrap every layer of the foundation in SOX-compliant security — access controls, change management, segregation of duties, and audit trails across ingestion, storage, modeling, and consumption. 

- Manage data infrastructure as code with Terraform — so environments, permissions, and changes are versioned, reviewable, and auditable. 

- Partner with Information Security, Internal Audit, and Finance — supporting control testing, audit requests, and remediation with clear evidence. 

- Protect sensitive and personal data throughout the foundation — classification, masking, and handling standards applied consistently. 
 
 Team Leadership

 

- Build and lead a high-caliber data engineering team — including the Principal Data Engineer, who serves as the team’s technical architect. 

- Set engineering standards in partnership with the Principal Data Engineer — code review, testing, deployment, and documentation practices the whole team delivers to. 

- Develop engineers and build a team people want to join — clear growth paths, real ownership, and protection from low-value work. 
 
 Candidate Requirements and Experience

 

- 12+ years of experience in data engineering, including significant time leading data engineering teams in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology. 

- Proven experience building an integrated data foundation for a GTM organization at scale, bringing together CRM, marketing, customer success, partner, financial, and product data. 

- Expert proficiency in SQL and Python, required. 

- Hands-on experience managing data infrastructure as code with Terraform, required. 

- Deep experience with cloud data warehouses, transformation frameworks, orchestration, and data quality tooling, and with designing data models for analytical use. 

- Experience integrating and managing third-party data sources and vendors, including intent, firmographic, contact, and technographic data. 

- Demonstrated experience operating data environments under SOX controls, including access management, change management, and audit support. Public company experience is highly recommended. 

- Experience working with product telemetry and event data at scale is highly recommended. 

- Hands-on proficiency with modern AI tools and a clear point of view on their application to data engineering — including practical experience building data resources that AI tools can query accurately, and using AI assistants to accelerate development and testing. 

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred. 
 
 

 Work Location: This role is fully remote for candidates who reside outside the 30 mile radius of one of our offices. For candidates who reside within a 30 mile radius of one of our offices, this role is Hybrid and would require 3 days a week (T, W, TH) in office.

Your Impact 

 The GTM Business Systems Director serves as the business owner of GTM capabilities, requirements, and adoption for the systems our GTM teams run on (CRM, CPQ, CLM, and related systems). They act as the business owner of how all DISCO’s GTM teams work and what they need from their systems. Own the ranked list of GTM business capability needs and the business case behind each. Make final prioritization and tradeoff calls on competing requests within GTM, bringing a unified list to IT.

- AI Integration in GTM Workflows: Leverage the latest best practices and AI features to accelerate GTM performance and business system ROI. 

- UAT, Acceptance & Change Management: Define acceptance criteria before build, run user acceptance testing, and own training, communications, and adoption for GTM releases. 

- GTM Demand & Tradeoff Decisions: Serve as the decisive voice on which GTM business needs matter most and which are deferred. Understand the bigger corporate picture to effectively make tough tradeoff decisions on implementation sequencing and screen/rank system requests on ROI. 

- GTM Process Standards Ownership: Own the process governance and standard operating procedures for how GTM teams use their systems, ensuring out-of-the-box capabilities are leveraged before resorting to custom technical debt. 

- GTM Team Mentorship: Serve as a mentor and role model for business systems and operations professionals across the organization, guiding teams to leverage best practices. 
 
 Who You Are 

 

- 15+ years of experience in Business Systems, Business Architecture, Internal Product Management, or Revenue Operations. 

- Proven experience setting enterprise-level strategy, influencing C-suite decisions, and driving alignment across departments. 

- Experience with agile methodologies, writing rigorous functional specifications/user stories, and managing tradeoffs. 

- Demonstrated experience running UAT, training, and adoption programs for enterprise systems. 

- Expertise in modern GTM platforms, understanding software capabilities well enough to challenge proposed solutions. 

- Exceptional collaboration and executive presence, with the ability to set business strategy with a CRO and immediately pivot to speaking functional behavior with IT partners. 

- Knowledge of complex business processes (e.g., Lead-to-Cash) and how data must flow across multiple platforms. 

- Knowledge of SOX / public company compliance practices to ensure compatibility with DISCO’s SOX compliance responsibilities. 

- Bachelor's degree required. 
 
 Even Better If You Have…

 Perks of DISCO 

 

- Open, inclusive, and fun environment 

- Benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, as well as 401(k) 

- Competitive salary plus RSUs 

- Flexible PTO 

- Opportunity to be a part of a company that is revolutionizing the legal industry 

- Growth opportunities throughout the company 
 About DISCO 

 DISCO provides a cloud-native, artificial intelligence-powered legal solution that simplifies ediscovery, legal document review and case management for enterprises, law firms, legal services providers and governments. Our scalable, integrated solution enables legal departments to easily collect, process and review enterprise data that is relevant or potentially relevant to legal matters.

With a single API key, developers can enable agents to search and retrieve information, fill out forms, and take action across websites. Today, Browserbase powers more than 50 million browser sessions each month for over 10,000 customers, including Ramp, DeepMind, Clay, Vercel, and Notion.

 We're a Series B startup that's tripled our headcount in 2 years, and we're continuing to grow, fast. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, CRV, and Notable Capital, our team is building on our CEO's founding vision to power the world's best AI tools and help everyone automate the web.

 About the role

 This is the founding hire on the Revenue Operations team! We’re pretty excited about it. It’s also the first one focused squarely on sales strategy and analytics, so you should have a background in Sales Ops. You will report to and work in close partnership with our RevOps Lead, along with our Head of Sales, Head of Growth, Head of Finance, AEs, and TCSMs. This role is based in San Francisco where the full team is, and we are open to New York for the right candidate.

 At Browserbase, we sell a usage-based product through two motions: a self-serve funnel that thousands of developers enter on their own, and an enterprise sales team that turns the best of those (and fresh outbound accounts) into large, expanding deals. This role would have to understand our revenue model to help impact strategic sales decisions like segmenting, forecasting, and compensation.

 What you'll do

 

- Segmentation analysis: Run the closed-won and expansion analysis that tells us how we should be carving the market and strategize the best way to ensure coverage, account assignment, and quota. 

- Quota and capacity modeling. Build the capacity models, quota scenarios, and SDR target math that Sales leadership and Finance make decisions from. Model the levers before we pull them and bring them, with an opinion, to the team. 

- Forecast modeling and inspection: Build and maintain the forecast model, prep the weekly call, inspect the deals behind the number, and flag where it is likely wrong before anyone else notices. You are our eyes and ears and we rely on you to make sure the data is correct. 

- Funnel and pipeline analytics: Partner with our team on filling in the funnel from self-serve signup to PQL to SQO to closed-won to expansion. Surface the conversion points worth fixing, jump in with recommendations, and help us get creative on moving the number. We’ve worked with RevOps people before who stay squarely out of the strategic decisions and work, this job isn’t it! We want you excited by the problems and to partner on solving them. 

- Systems troubleshooting. Understand the systems generating our numbers (HubSpot, Snowflake, Stripe, product data) well enough to triage them. 

- Market sizing and targeting. Use enrichment tooling to size segments, build target account lists, and support outbound planning. 

- Deal desk support. Help on pricing approvals and deal structure as volume grows. Secondary to everything above, but part of the job. 
 
 Requirements

 

- 3 to 5 years in sales operations, revenue operations, sales strategy, or GTM strategy and operations at a B2B SaaS or developer tools company. A consulting or finance background with at least two years in an operating seat also works. 

- Real analytical chops. You can build a segmentation analysis, a capacity model, and a forecast, and you know which one the question calls for. SQL or equivalent, plus actual modeling, not just pivot tables. 

- You can take a defined piece of a larger problem and run it to a real answer without needing to own the whole thing. 

- Great collaboration with Sales. Your customers at Browserbase will be internal so that means working well with AEs and jamming on strategic reports with the Head of Sales. 

- Hands-on with HubSpot or Salesforce. You know the objects, the reporting layer, and where the data actually comes from. 

- You have worked on a forecast before and understand what makes one wrong. 

- Genuine AI tooling fluency. You use Claude, Codex, or similar to write queries, prototype internal tools, and move faster. When building something yourself is the fastest path, you build it. 

- Low ego, high ownership. We are small and the job will definitely change. 
 
 Nice to haves

 

- Usage-based or consumption pricing experience. 

- Experience supporting both self-serve and enterprise motions, and an instinct for how they should reinforce each other. 

- Clay, Amplemarket, Outreach, or similar for enrichment, TAM building, and outbound tooling. 

- Quota and comp plan design experience. We are not hiring a dedicated comp analyst, but knowing how plans behave is valuable. 

- Snowflake, dbt, or a BI tool like Hex, Looker, or Tableau. 

- Deal desk or CPQ exposure. 

- You have been an early ops hire before and know what breaks beyond a Series B. 
 
 Benefits

 

- Competitive salary + meaningful early-stage equity 

- Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents 

- 401(k) 

- Daily catered lunches with a fully-stocked kitchen 

- Beautiful office in downtown San Francisco 

- All the AI tools + credits you want 

- Regular team offsites and company events 
 Base Compensation $120,000 — $160,000 USD Browserbase is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Associate GTM Engineer
description:
Who We Are 

 At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people. 

 We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. If you’d like to work in a supportive, entrepreneurial environment, are interested in building something meaningful and having fun while doing it, we’d love to hear from you. 

 We're united by shared goals and shared motivations at Justworks. These are best summed up in our company values, which are reflected in our product and in our team. 

 Our Values 

 If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in. 

 Who You Are 

 You've spent two or three years making a GTM stack work: Salesforce, a marketing automation platform, the routing and enrichment tools around them. You know where the fragile parts are because you've fixed them before a campaign launch. Now you're done configuring the same thing twice. You've started building with AI, and you've seen that one person with AI resources and a clear problem can ship in a week what used to take a quarter.

 You understand marketing, not just the tools marketing uses. You know how a lead becomes an MQL, why attribution breaks, what a campaign needs before it goes live, and why marketers wait on ops for things they should do themselves.

 You want to stop being the person who keeps the old system running and become the person who builds the next one. This role is designed for that move.

 The Role 

 As an Associate GTM Engineer, you'll build the AI-native systems that run marketing operations at Justworks, and you'll own the stack those systems sit on. In your first year, that means shipping things like a campaign QA agent that catches broken tracking before launch, an inbound agent behind our website chat and voice bots that qualifies and routes buyers in real time, and self-serve tooling that lets marketers launch campaigns without waiting on ops. You'll work with LLM APIs, MCP, Salesforce and Customer.io APIs, and Snowflake, and every system you build will report its own impact.

 You'll report directly to the Director of Revenue Strategy & Operations and work in a pod with Marketing. GTM Engineers will review your code and teach you production standards. We're hiring at the junior end on purpose: we want someone to mentor into one of the strongest GTM engineers in the market. Escalate security or access questions to a GTM Engineer before production.

 What You'll Run 

 

- Marketing technology stack: Own the configuration and integration of Salesforce, Customer.io, and the routing and enrichment tools between them. Keep UTMs, conversion events, and campaign records flowing cleanly. 

- Lead lifecycle: Maintain intake, enrichment, scoring, routing, and suppression. Implement the MQL rules Marketing defines as monitored logic, and replace manual steps with agents where it makes sense. 

- Data integrity: Run audits, deduplication, and field governance. Build automated checks so data problems surface before downstream teams find them. 

- Pipeline operations: Run and monitor the agents and automations that move inbound pipeline, and own their uptime the way a product engineer owns a service. 
 
 Admin work here is something you engineer away, not a permanent part of the job. If you've done a task by hand twice, the third time should be automated.

 Where This Goes 

 This role is the entry point to our GTM Engineering ladder. The next step is GTM Engineer : you'll own production applications end to end across the full revenue motion, with promotion based on scope of impact.

 Qualifications 

 Required 

 

- 2–3 years in Salesforce administration, marketing operations, business systems, or a related technical GTM role. 

- Hands-on Salesforce experience: Flows, validation rules, objects, and campaign structures, and how CRM data drives GTM workflows. 

- Marketing operations fluency: lead lifecycle, MQL and routing logic, campaign setup, UTMs and attribution, and consent. 

- Evidence that you've built something with AI or code: an agent, an integration, an internal tool, or a script that replaced a manual process. Show us; a GitHub link or demo beats a certification. 

- Working ability in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, plus Git basics. You don't need deep software engineering experience, but you need to read, write, and debug code with AI assistance. 

- SQL fundamentals. 

- Clear written communication. You can document a system so someone else can run it. 
 
 Preferred 

 

- Experience administering Customer.io or a comparable platform (Marketo, HubSpot, Braze, Iterable). 

- Experience with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, or MCP. 

- Experience with routing and enrichment tools (LeanData, Chili Piper, Clay) or workflow tools (n8n, Zapier). 

- Experience with conversational or voice AI products. 

- Salesforce Administrator certification. 
 
 How We Work: COGIS 

 

- Camaraderie: Work together toward a higher purpose. Listen actively and help others. 

- Openness: Share information, consider new possibilities, and stay receptive to feedback. 

- Grit: Commit to the work and see it through. 

- Integrity: Do what you say and say what you'll do. 

- Simplicity: Make things as simple as possible, but no simpler. 
 
 The base wage range for this position based in our New York City Office is targeted at $98,000.00 to $122,000.00 per year. This role is required to work a hybrid schedule including 2 days a week from our office at 55 Water Street, in New York City. 

 
 #LI-BF1
#LI-Hybrid 

 Actual compensation is based on multiple factors that are unique to each candidate, including and not limited to skill set, level of relevant experience, and specific work location. Salary ranges for positions based in other locations may differ based on the cost of labor in that location. 

 For more information about Justworks’ Total Reward Philosophy, including all of the perks and benefits we are proud to offer our team members, please visit Total Rewards @ Justworks . 

 Diversity At Justworks 

 Justworks is committed to maintaining a workplace where diversity of identity, culture, and life experience is the norm and is celebrated authentically and respected consistently. Diversity in our work, our people, and our product drives creativity and innovation, entrepreneurial leadership and integrity, competitiveness, and collaboration throughout our business and in the market. We depend on our differences to make our team stronger, our workplace more dynamic, and our product accessible to all of our customers.

We also provide reasonable accommodations to employees based on their sincerely held religious beliefs, as well as for other covered reasons consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.  Our Values

 About the role 

 Justworks is building a connected go-to-market operating model across a multi-product platform with self-service, hybrid, partner, and managed-sales motions.

 The Marketing Operations Manager — Funnel & Lifecycle will own the operational processes, data requirements, and business rules that help prospects and customers move through the right journey at the right time.

 You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Partnerships, Product, and Customer Success to translate their strategies into effective intake, enrichment, scoring, routing, segmentation, nurture eligibility, and lifecycle triggers. You will use data and AI to help these teams make better decisions and identify where prospects and customers are getting stuck or overlooked.

 This is a hands-on individual-contributor role. You will work closely with Campaign Operations to turn journey requirements into coordinated execution, and with GTM Technology and Analytics to ensure the underlying systems and measurement support those journeys.

 What you’ll do 

 

- Map and improve prospect and customer journeys across products, channels, and self-service, hybrid, partner, and managed-sales paths. 

- Own lead-management processes including intake, enrichment, qualification, scoring, routing, handoffs, recycling, and re-engagement. 

- Partner with Marketing and other GTM teams to define how customer needs, behaviors, and signals should inform the next action.

- Partner with GTM Planning & Analysis to measure conversion, journey progression, routing accuracy, speed to lead, and handoff quality. 

- Use AI and experimentation to improve prioritization, segmentation, decision-making, and exception detection. 

- Maintain documentation, monitoring, and governance so journey rules remain reliable as the business evolves. 
 
 What you’ll bring 

 

- 6+ years of experience in marketing operations, revenue operations, lifecycle operations, growth operations, or a related function. 

- Experience supporting a multi-product B2B technology business with both self-service or product-led and sales-assisted motions. 

- Strong knowledge of lead management, scoring, routing, segmentation, nurture, and lifecycle orchestration. 

- Experience translating business strategies into operational rules across CRM, marketing automation, and customer-engagement platforms. 

- Comfort working with firmographic, behavioral, product-usage, engagement, and customer data. 

- Strong analytical judgment and the ability to identify why prospects or customers are failing to progress. 

- A track record of improving processes across teams and systems. 

- Excellent cross-functional partnership skills and the ability to build agreement around shared decisions. 

- Practical experience using AI and automation to improve GTM operations. 
 
 What success looks like 

 

- Prospects and customers enter appropriate journeys and receive timely, relevant follow-up. 

- Routing, handoffs, nurture eligibility, and lifecycle rules are clear, accurate, and trusted. 

- Fewer prospects and customers are lost, stalled, misrouted, or exposed to conflicting outreach. 

- Marketing and GTM teams use shared journey definitions and have visibility into where improvements are needed. 

- Journey improvements contribute to stronger conversion, adoption, retention, and expansion.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
About Versapay 🚀
 
Versapay is the platform that rewires AR by removing barriers from collecting and reconciling B2B payments, providing end-to-end cash flow clarity and ensuring businesses can manage working capital on their terms.
 
 By closing the loop for finance teams and their business systems, customers, and payment activity into a single intelligent ecosystem, Versapay transforms money matters into a data-driven advantage. With 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting, Versapay facilitates 110M+ transactions and processes $300B+ in payments volume annually. 
 
Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!
 
 
 


About the role

Versapay is hiring its first GTM Engineer to remove manual work from the revenue engine, speed up response to inbound demand, and run automated outbound plays for Sales and Marketing. You will design, build and maintain the workflows, integrations and AI agents that connect our GTM systems, with Salesforce as the system of record.

This is a builder role inside Revenue Operations and reports to VP of Revenue Operations. You will own problems end to end: find where reps and marketers lose time, design the fix, ship it, and measure the result. We care about hours given back to the field and faster pipeline, not about how many tools/workflows you deploy.


What you'll do
Speed to lead and inbound orchestration 

- Own the inbound path from form fill or meeting request to first rep touch, and cut response time to minutes. 

- Build lead-to-account matching, qualification and routing logic, with clear SLAs and alerts when they are missed. 

- Design and automate instant follow-up: rep notifications, meeting booking, and context-rich handoffs so reps know who they are talking to before they call. 

   
 Automated plays for Sales and Marketing 

- In partnership with marketing design signal-based plays, for example website visits from target accounts, product or event engagement, job changes of known champions, and renewal or expansion triggers. 

- Turn each signal into an action: a task, an alert, a sequence enrollment or an account brief for the right owner. 

- Partner with Marketing on campaign follow-up, event lead processing and nurture handoffs so no lead sits untouched. 

   
 Eliminating manual work 

- Map where reps, SDRs, marketers and CSMs spend time on low-value tasks, and rank fixes by hours saved. 

- Automate CRM hygiene: field completion, duplicate prevention, activity capture and stage-change requirements. 

- Build AI-assisted workflows such as pre-call account research, call summaries written back to Salesforce, follow-up email drafts and deal-risk flags. 

   
 Data and enrichment 

- Improve coverage and accuracy of account and contact data using our current data sources. 

- Support the evaluation if we choose a dedicated enrichment and orchestration platform (for example Clay), and lead its rollout if approved. 

   
 Systems, integrations and governance 

- Support integrations between Salesforce, marketing automation, sales engagement, conversation intelligence and other GTM tools, using APIs, webhooks and workflow platforms. 

- Work within Salesforce data-model and change-control standards set with the Salesforce admin team. 

- Document every workflow: what it does, what it writes, who owns it and how to turn it off.

What you'll bring
Required 

- 4+ years in a technical GTM role such as GTM engineering, RevOps systems, marketing ops engineering or sales ops automation at a B2B SaaS company. 

- Deep working knowledge of Salesforce: objects, fields, flows, validation rules, and how lead, contact, account and opportunity data relate. 

- Hands-on experience building production workflows in at least one automation platform, such as n8n, Workato, Make, Zapier or Tray. 

- Comfort with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and authentication; able to read API docs and connect two systems without vendor help. 

- Working scripting skills in Python or JavaScript, and basic SQL. 

- Practical experience using LLMs in workflows: prompt design, structured outputs, testing for accuracy, and knowing when not to use AI. 

- A track record of shipping automations that measurably saved time or improved conversion, with numbers to show it. 

- Clear written documentation habits and the judgment to build things others can maintain. 

 Nice to have 

- Experience with Clay or similar enrichment and orchestration tools (Apollo, ZoomInfo workflows, Common Room). 

- Experience with lead routing and scheduling tools such as LeanData or Chili Piper. 

- Experience with intent platforms, such as 6sense or Demandbase 

- Familiarity with marketing automation (ex., HubSpot) and sales engagement platforms (Outreach, Salesloft, Gong Engage). 

- Exposure to a data warehouse and reverse ETL (ex., Snowflake). 

- Experience in a PE-backed or fast-scaling SaaS company, or in fintech, payments or AR/AP software.

How we'll measure success
Success means faster pipeline and fewer manual hours, measured against a baseline set in your first 30 days.
