title: GTM Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a GTM Engineer based in the United States. 

 As the first GTM Engineer within a growing Growth Marketing team, you will help build the technical foundations that power more efficient and scalable go-to-market operations.
You will work across Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, Business Systems, and Customer Success to identify operational challenges and turn them into practical technical solutions.
Through automation, data integration, and AI-enabled workflows, you will reduce repetitive tasks and improve segmentation, routing, personalization, and commercial execution.
You will take ownership of projects from initial discovery and requirements gathering through implementation, launch, and continuous improvement.
Your work will help strengthen data quality, accelerate sales processes, and create more effective collaboration across commercial teams.
Success in this role will be measured by tangible improvements in pipeline growth, deal velocity, and overall team productivity.

Accountabilities:
You will design and deliver the systems, integrations, and automation workflows that support the organization's go-to-market strategy. Working closely with stakeholders across commercial functions, you will translate business needs into scalable solutions, evaluate their impact, and continuously improve the technology ecosystem.

- 
 Design and implement AI-enabled workflows and automations across Growth Marketing and the broader commercial organization.

 

- 
 Improve segmentation, lead and account routing, personalization, and day-to-day operational efficiency.

 

- 
 Lead requirements-gathering sessions with Marketing, Sales, RevOps, Business Systems, and Customer Success teams.

 

- 
 Translate complex or ambiguous business challenges into clear technical designs, implementation plans, and measurable success criteria.

 

- 
 Connect CRM, marketing automation, enrichment, sales engagement, and data platforms through reliable integrations and pipelines.

 

- 
 Maintain high data quality through effective schemas, deduplication processes, audits, and dashboards.

 

- 
 Experiment with new workflows, tools, and data sources, measuring their impact on pipeline, revenue, and time savings.

 

- 
 Determine which solutions should be scaled, refined, or discontinued based on performance and business value.

 

- 
 Evaluate the existing go-to-market technology stack and recommend when to build, purchase, or consolidate solutions.

 

- 
 Document workflows and technical implementations so that other team members can maintain and extend them.

 

- 
 Contribute to vendor selection and assessment when strategically relevant.

 

 Requirements: 

 The ideal candidate combines extensive experience in B2B marketing or revenue operations with strong technical capabilities in automation, data, and systems integration. You should be comfortable owning projects end to end, making informed technical decisions, and collaborating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- 
 At least 8 years of experience in marketing or revenue operations within a B2B organization.

 

- 
 At least 2 years of hands-on experience building go-to-market systems.

 

- 
 Experience working with modern CRM platforms, enrichment and data providers, sales engagement tools, marketing automation platforms, and the integrations connecting them.

 

- 
 Demonstrated ability to take GTM projects from initial business requirements through production deployment and ongoing adoption.

 

- 
 Ability to explain technical decisions, system architecture, data sources, implementation trade-offs, and measurable business outcomes.

 

- 
 Strong understanding of when rule-based automation is sufficient and when AI-enabled solutions provide additional value.

 

- 
 Technical proficiency with SQL and at least one of Python or JavaScript.

 

- 
 Experience working with REST APIs, webhooks, and orchestration or enrichment platforms such as Clay or n8n.

 

- 
 Understanding of data modeling, account hierarchies, permissions, and data governance principles.

 

- 
 Experience deploying AI-enabled workflows or agents into production, monitoring their outputs, and managing associated costs.

 

- 
 Regular use of AI tools to improve personal productivity and work processes.

 

- 
 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to facilitate requirements sessions, explain technical concepts to non-technical colleagues, and document solutions clearly.

 

- 
 Strong collaboration skills and enthusiasm for working across Marketing, Sales, RevOps, Business Systems, and Customer Success.

 

- 
 Preferred: Experience in life sciences, clinical research, or healthcare go-to-market environments.

 

- 
 Ability to remain focused and attentive while managing responsibilities, learn new instructions, communicate effectively, and work at a stationary workstation for extended periods.

 

- 
 Ability to regularly lift, carry, and lower objects weighing up to 10 pounds.

 

 Benefits: 

- 
 Annual base salary ranging from $100,000 to $184,000, depending on location, skills, and experience.

 

- 
 Potential eligibility for a variable bonus in addition to base salary.

 

- 
 Health coverage.

 

- 
 Paid holidays.

 

- 
 Additional employee benefits.

title: GTM Systems Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a GTM Systems Engineer based in the United States.

title: Sales Operations Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sales Operations Specialist based in Ireland. 

 We are looking for a proactive and data-driven Sales Operations Specialist to strengthen and optimize a growing international sales organization. In this role, you will play a central part in improving sales performance, pipeline visibility, forecasting accuracy, and operational efficiency. Working within the Revenue Operations team, you will connect commercial strategy with day-to-day sales execution and enablement. You will leverage AI-powered tools and automation to simplify workflows, enhance sales productivity, and support data-driven decision-making. You will also design and scale onboarding initiatives that help new sales hires become productive faster. This is an exciting opportunity to shape modern sales operations in a fast-growing B2B SaaS environment with an international and collaborative team.

Accountabilities:
- Sales Performance & Pipeline Analysis: Monitor sales performance using existing dashboards and analyze revenue leakages, pipeline velocity, conversion rates, win rates, and potential bottlenecks. Translate findings into actionable recommendations to improve commercial performance. 

- Forecasting & Business Intelligence: Collaborate with sales leadership to improve forecast accuracy, monitor performance against targets, assess pipeline health, and identify potential deal risks using AI-assisted analytics and predictive forecasting tools. 

- Sales Cadence & Business Reviews: Own and coordinate Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), ensuring sales performance is regularly assessed and that teams remain aligned with commercial objectives and priorities. 

- Sales Execution Support: Provide day-to-day operational support to sales representatives, assisting with pipeline management, closing activities, and operational queries to facilitate deal progression. 

- Deal Process Optimization: Work closely with Deal Desk and GTM Systems Engineering teams to simplify deal workflows, eliminate administrative friction, and improve the overall sales experience. 

- AI & Workflow Automation: Identify, implement, and optimize AI-powered sales workflows, including conversation intelligence, automated CRM data capture, deal coaching prompts, and other productivity-enhancing solutions. 

- Sales Onboarding & Enablement: Design, structure, and develop a comprehensive Sales Academy to support the onboarding and continuous development of commercial team members. 

- Training & Performance Development: Build structured learning paths, pitch certification programs, and ongoing training initiatives to reduce ramp-up time and accelerate new hires' time-to-first-deal. 

- AI-Driven Sales Training: Introduce AI-powered scenario simulations, automated role-play assessments, and on-demand pitch coaching to make sales enablement more scalable and effective. 

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with sales leadership and other go-to-market stakeholders to strengthen operational alignment, improve processes, and support international growth. 

 Requirements:

- Professional Experience: 4–6 years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations (RevOps), or a similar role within a fast-growing B2B SaaS or technology company. 

- Sales Operations Expertise: Strong understanding of complex B2B and enterprise sales cycles, pipeline management, revenue forecasting, sales performance metrics, and Quarterly Business Reviews. 

- AI & Technical Skills: Hands-on experience with AI-powered tools and coding environments such as Cursor, Claude Code, Bolt, Replit, or AI-assisted Python and JavaScript development. 

- Automation & Prototyping: Ability to use AI tools effectively to build functional prototypes, test APIs, troubleshoot automation scripts, and develop practical solutions to operational challenges. 

- Sales Enablement Experience: Proven experience designing and implementing structured sales onboarding programs, training initiatives, or sales academies that measurably improve employee ramp-up time. 

- Analytical Capabilities: Strong analytical and diagnostic mindset, with the ability to interpret revenue dashboards, identify performance gaps, detect operational inefficiencies, and recommend effective improvements. 

- Business Acumen: Understanding of commercial operations and the ability to translate business objectives into practical processes, tools, and performance initiatives. 

- Communication & Collaboration: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust with sales representatives, collaborate with leadership, and drive alignment across teams. 

- Problem-Solving Mindset: Hands-on, proactive, and solution-oriented approach, with a willingness to experiment, take ownership, and continuously improve existing processes. 

- Language Skills: Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English. French proficiency is considered a strong advantage. 

- Builder Mindset: Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, particularly AI-driven solutions that improve productivity, automate repetitive tasks, and transform sales operations. 

 Candidates who do not meet every listed requirement but bring relevant experience and a strong motivation to contribute are also encouraged to apply.

 Benefits:

- Fully remote working opportunities across Europe. 

- Flexible location options, with the possibility of working from designated office locations where applicable. 

- Full-time professional engagement under a contract arrangement. 

- Opportunity to contribute to the development of a growing international SaaS business. 

- Exposure to innovative AI-powered sales technologies, automation tools, and modern Revenue Operations practices. 

- Opportunities to design and lead strategic sales enablement and operational improvement initiatives. 

- Collaboration with experienced professionals across Sales, Finance, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations. 

- Professional development through hands-on experience with emerging technologies and evolving commercial strategies. 

- Company-funded professional travel when required. 

- Inclusive and diverse working environment that values different backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

title: Senior Manager, Revenue Operations

title: Revenue Operations Manager - Spotify Technology
description:
Spotify Technology is our business-to-business software team, helping organizations improve how they build and deliver software. Our products, including Backstage Portal, Confidence, and Xirp, support developers and AI-powered systems as they navigate increasingly complex engineering environments.
As Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own revenue operations for Spotify Technology, helping our sales organization scale from early growth to a mature, segmented go-to-market model. This is a hands-on role where you'll work closely with the business day to day, identify challenges early, and build the systems, processes, and insights that enable sustainable growth.
You'll partner with Sales leadership, Marketing, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success to improve how we operate across the customer lifecycle. You'll balance strategic planning with practical execution, creating structure that helps our teams work efficiently as the business evolves.


What You'll Do
• Own sales operations for Spotify Technology, including CRM, pipeline management, forecasting, territory and account assignment, and deal desk processes.

 • Design and roll out a segmented sales model that evolves our go-to-market approach as the business matures.

 • Build infrastructure and systems to support a scalable Commercial sales motion (companies with fewer than 1,000 employees), focused on faster deal cycles, efficient lead routing, and repeatable processes.

 • Build infrastructure and systems to support a strategic Enterprise sales motion (companies with 1,000+ employees), enabling prospecting, account planning, and multi-product engagements.

 • Partner with the Director of Sales as a strategic advisor on quota setting, capacity planning, compensation, territory design, and headcount modeling.

 • Support revenue across the full customer lifecycle, including new business, expansion, and retention.

 • Build reporting and dashboards to track pipeline coverage, conversion rates, time to close, forecast accuracy, and net revenue retention by segment.

 • Strengthen forecasting discipline and maintain a healthy, predictable pipeline through effective reporting and sales processes.

 • Identify friction across the sales process, including handoffs between Account Executives, Sales Engineering, and Customer Success, and drive improvements with cross-functional partners.

 • Partner with Marketing on pipeline generation reporting, lead management, and process improvements.

 • Establish and continuously improve operating rhythms, including forecast calls, pipeline reviews, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs), as the business scales.

 • Evaluate and manage the go-to-market (GTM) technology stack to support efficient and scalable sales operations.

Who You Are
• You have 6+ years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, or go-to-market strategy, with a track record of meaningful impact at a senior level.

 • You have experience scaling sales operations through a startup or high-growth phase and understand when to introduce new processes and structure.

 • You can build systems and processes from the ground up without adding unnecessary complexity.

 • You are proficient in using AI and can lead initiatives that improve sales effectiveness through AI-enabled tools and processes.

 • You have experience in B2B SaaS, ideally within developer platforms, DevOps tools, or cloud services.

 • You understand the differences between product-led growth (PLG), Commercial, and Enterprise sales motions and have experience designing segmented sales models.

 • You understand complex technical sales involving Sales Engineering and recognize the importance of customer retention and post-sale success in revenue strategy.

 • You have hands-on experience with Salesforce or a similar CRM, including building reports, workflows, and resolving data issues.

 • You use data to guide forecasting, capacity modeling, and funnel analysis, combining analytical skills with sound business judgment.

 • You can influence senior sales leaders, build alignment across teams, and drive decisions without formal authority.

 • You are comfortable working in evolving environments, adapting as priorities change, and helping shape how an innovative business grows.

Where You'll Be
• This role is based in London

 • We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.
